Central assistance will be restricted to one unit per individual beneficiary. 1. Projects with land on a long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance. The registered lease period or agreement must not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.
benefits: The scheme provides a subsidy for the construction of fish retail markets, including ornamental fish or aquarium markets. The project cost is ₹1,00,00,000/- per unit. The subsidy provided is: - 40% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category. - 60% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women categories.

title: PMMSY: Cycle with Ice Boxes-Haryana
description: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of cycles with ice boxes for fisheries activities. Through this scheme, central assistance is provided for newly purchased cycles with ice boxes for the initial crop. Eligibility: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. Beneficiaries should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition. 1. Beneficiaries shall be provided central assistance for Cycle with Ice box the initial crop only in the purchase of newly purchased Cycle with Ice Box 1. Central assistance for Cycle with Ice Box cost shall be released only for the fisheries activity. 1. Govt. of India and Govt. of Haryana shall not be responsible for any losses incurred on procurement, operation, maintenance and management of the fish transport facilities.
benefits: - The scheme provides a subsidy for the cycle with ice boxes for fisheries activities. - The project cost is ₹0.10/- lakh per unit. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries falling under the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries who are Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women. Note: The Government of India and the Government of Haryana shall not be responsible for any losses incurred on procurement, operation, maintenance, and management of the fish transport facilities.

title: PMMSY: Construction of New Rearing ponds - Haryana
description: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, financial assistance and subsidies are provided for the construction of new rearing ponds. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The construction of new rearing ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas, only under the construction of new ponds under the PMMSY scheme. 1. The applicant shall be provided with central assistance for the Construction of New Rearing unit costs for the initial crop only in the newly constructed ponds. 1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 7 (seven) years. 1. The applicant, having their land, must furnish revenue records with a clear land title.
benefits: - Provides financial assistance for the construction of New Rearing Ponds (nursery/seed rearing ponds). - The project cost of ₹ 7,00,000/- per Hectare is provided. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana
description: The scheme aims to promote hygienic and efficient fish transportation and retailing through mobile outlets. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for purchasing e-rickshaws equipped with ice boxes for selling fish directly. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that the fish transport facility (e-rickshaw) is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant is eligible to purchase only one new three-wheeler e-rickshaw with an ice box for fisheries activities under this scheme. 1. The applicant should agree that neither the Central Government nor the State Government shall be held responsible for any financial or operational losses incurred in the procurement, operation, maintenance, or management of the fish transport facilities.
benefits: Tangible Benefits: - Project Cost: ₹3,00,000/- per unit (for purchasing a three-wheeler e-rickshaw equipped with an ice-box for selling fish.) - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
description: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for new ponds in saline/alkaline areas. Through this scheme, polythene lining costs are provided to beneficiaries constructing new water bodies for fish/shrimp culture. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The polythene lining cost shall be provided for new water bodies created under the various state government. 1. Beneficiaries shall be provided with central assistance for the polythene lining cost for the initial crop only in newly constructed. 1. Central assistance for the Polythene lining cost shall be released only after the ponds are ready for fish/shrimp culture. 1. The projects having land on long-term lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance. However, the registered lease period/agreement shall not be a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹8,00,000/- per hectare. - The subsidy provided will be limited to 25% of the project cost for all categories.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Small RAS Culture System Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to boost inland fish production and create employment. It provides financial support for setting up Small RAS units for eligible beneficiaries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: Beneficiaries can receive assistance for the Establishment of Small RAS (with 1 tank of a minimum 100m3/tank capacity 10t/crop) culture system. 1. For the general category, the standard of assistance will be 40% of the unit cost ₹7,50,000/unit or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less. 1. For women, Scheduled Caste (SC), and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories, the standard of assistance will be 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less. Mode of Disbursement: Assistance is paid through 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments. Validity: The benefit can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery - Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: For the Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery, the unit cost of the project is ₹30,00,000/-. Assistance is provided as follows: 1. General category: 40% of the unit cost.1. Women, Scheduled Caste (SC), and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories: 60% of the unit cost.1. Funding structure: - 60% contribution from the Government of India. - 40% contribution from the State Government. Frequency of Disbursement: Once in a lifetime benefit per eligible beneficiary for this specific component.

title: Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The "Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve crop productivity through providing certified seeds at subsidized rates to all farmers across the state. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be residing in Gujarat.
benefits: - Seed Distribution: Certified seeds are distributed to eligible farmers.

title: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote organic agriculture by providing financial assistance for certification, transportation, and organic inputs to farmers across the state. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in organic farming activities.
benefits: - Organic Farming Registration and Certification Assistance (GOPCA): The scheme provides 75% at-source assistance in cost to the farmer for registration and certification when undertaken through the Gujarat Organic Products Certification Agency (GOPCA).- Organic Farming Registration, Certification, and Transportation Assistance (APEDA-approved agencies): When certification is done through APEDA-approved organic certification agencies, the scheme offers 50% assistance in registration, certification, and transportation fees. The maximum benefit for certification support is limited to ₹2,000/- per hectare.- Input Assistance for Organic Farming: Farmers are also eligible for input assistance amounting to ₹5,000/- per hectare to promote organic farming practices.

title: "Orthodox or Specialty Tea Production Subsidy" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
description: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam. Eligibility: General Eligibility - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam Production Subsidy Specific Eligibility - The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through Crush, Tear, Curl process). - The applicant must have started production on or after 1st of April, 2020.
benefits: Benefit Amount: ₹10/- per kilogram for Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea, or other Specialty tea Special Rate: ₹12/- per kilogram for applications of Financial Year 2023-24 only (tea production year 2022-23). Validity Period: Extended from Financial Year 2023-24 to 2027-28. Disbursement Mode: Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. Claim Deadline: Latest by 30th June on completion of every financial year. Additional Benefit: Provided in addition to any other subsidy claimed from the Tea Board of India or any other agency.

title: Scheme to Provide Stipend to the Persons With Disabilities of the State for Poultry Training
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The "Scheme to Provide Stipend to the Persons With Disabilities of the State for Poultry Training" aims to promote poultry rearing skills among persons with disabilities through a ₹2,000/- stipend for attending a 7-day training program conducted by the Intensive Poultry Development Unit. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a person with physical disabilities, holding a valid PH Identity Card. - The applicant should express interest in poultry rearing and be willing to attend the full 7-day training session.
benefits: - Stipend Amount: ₹2,000/- per beneficiary.

title: "Subsidy for Orthodox & Speciality Tea Unit for Plant & Machinery" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
description: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam. Eligibility: General Eligibility - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes. - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea. - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam. - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam. Plant & Machinery Subsidy Specific Eligibility - The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through Crush, Tear, Curl process). - The applicant must have started production on or after 01-04-2020 and before 31-03-2028. - The applicant must be either an entirely new unit or an existing unit which has expanded its capacity by creating additional infrastructure for production of Orthodox and Speciality Tea. - The applicant must use all new machinery (no subsidy available on second hand machinery or parts of a machine). - The applicant must not have claimed any similar subsidy under any other scheme of the Government of India or the State.
benefits: Benefit Amount: 25% of the cost of Plant & Machinery. Maximum Amount: ₹30,00,000/- or 25% of actual cost, whichever is less. Validity Period: Units starting production on or after 01-04-2020 and before 31-03-2028. Claim Period: Within 12 months of the start of commercial manufacturing activities. Disbursement Mode: Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. Post-Selection Condition: Manufacturing unit shall not sell the machinery before expiry of at least 5 years from start of manufacturing.

title: Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme “Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program” aims to support mechanization in agriculture through financial aid for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to all eligible farmers across the state. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in agricultural practices and require mechanization support. - The applicant should intend to purchase either a mini tractor up to 20 HP, or a power tiller (either above or below 8 BHP).
benefits: Mini Tractors up to 20 HP and Power Tillers above 8 BHP: - General Category Farmers: Financial assistance of ₹45,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.- SC/ST Farmers: Financial assistance of ₹60,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less. Power Tillers Below 8 BHP: - General Category Farmers: Financial assistance of ₹40,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.- SC/ST Farmers: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.

title: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Training of Scheduled Caste trainees Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) people engaged in inland fisheries activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Reservation: The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
benefits: 1. The trainee is paid a stipend of ₹1,250/- after completing ten days of training. 1. The stipend is paid at the rate of ₹125/- per day. Training Duration: 10 days of fisheries training. Frequency of Disbursement: Once in a lifetime.

title: National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm: Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme component "Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm and reduce imports by providing financial assistance for maintenance and intercropping. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: - First Year: ₹10,500/-. - Second Year: ₹10,500/-. - Third Year: ₹10,500/-. - Fourth Year: ₹10,500/-.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of open Sea cages (100-120)m3 vol. - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to support the installation of open sea cages of 100–120 cubic meter capacity for fish farming in marine waters. This helps fishermen and entrepreneurs to undertake cage-based aquaculture, thereby increasing fish production, ensuring sustainable marine resource utilization. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. Preference/Reservation/Relaxation: - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
benefits: Establishment of Open Sea Cages (100-120 m³ volume): - The estimated unit cost is ₹5,00,000/- for the general category against ₹(Rs.) 40% assistance, i.e., ₹2,00,000/- or 40% of the purchase (whichever is less). - 60% contribution of the central government and 40% of the state government will be in the assistance received. - 1 Sea-Cage unit under this scheme against the estimated unit cost of ₹ 5,00,00,000/- for women/SC/ST. 60% assistance for the category, i.e. assistance of ₹ 3,00,000/- or 60 % of the actual purchase, whichever is less, is available to the beneficiary. - 60% contribution of the central government and 40% of the state government will be in the assistance received. The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India. Remarks: 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. Minimum…

title: PMMSY : Modernization of Cold storage /Ice Plant - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for the modernisation of Cold storage /Ice Plant. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. Preference/Reservation/Relaxation: - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
benefits: - Unit cost is ₹50,00,000/-. 40% assistance for the general category, i.e. assistance up to ₹ 20,00,000/- and for women and ST/SC category beneficiaries 60%, i.e. assistance up to ₹ 30,00,000/-. - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India. Remarks: 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: Once in a lifetime.

title: PMMSY:  Establishment of Bio-toilets in mechanised fishing vessels - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to provide sanitation facilities on mechanised fishing vessels. It provides financial assistance depending on category, with once-in-a-lifetime eligibility. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. Preference/Reservation/Relaxation: - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - General category beneficiaries: 40% assistance, i.e. ₹20,000/-. - Women and ST/SC category beneficiaries: 60% assistance, i.e. ₹30,000/-. - Unit Cost: ₹50,000/-. - Target Allocation: Benefits will be available as per the category allocation decided by the Government of India. Mode of Disbursement: Contribution is shared: 60% from Government of India, 40% from State Governments. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit is provided only once. Validity: Available once in a lifetime.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state, helping them understand the nutrient composition of their soil and the type and quantity of fertilizers suitable for their crops. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must own agricultural land in the state and be actively engaged in farming activities.
benefits: - To provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state. - The soil of each farmer’s field is tested at soil testing laboratories, which are operational in all 13 districts. - Farmers receive detailed information about the nutrient content of their soil, along with recommendations on the type and quantity of fertilizers best suited for their crops. - Soil testing is provided free of cost to farmers. - In hilly areas, a Soil Health Card is issued for agricultural land up to 2.5 hectares, while in plain areas, it is issued for land up to 10 hectares. Each card is valid for three years.

title: Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi
description: The scheme aims to guide farmers and youth in biotechnology-based farming and animal husbandry by providing technical training and solutions to enhance self-employment and income generation. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youth, a farmer, a member of a self-help group, or a livestock farmer.
benefits: Through Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi, the Council provides technical guidance from subject matter experts to the state’s farmers, helping to address challenges in biotechnology-based agriculture and animal husbandry. The Council also continuously works to improve farmers’ livelihoods and promote self-employment by sharing technical knowledge on hydroponics, soilless farming, kiwifruit cultivation, fish farming, beekeeping, vegetable production, and floriculture.

title: Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals
description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to livestock owners for losses due to wild animal attacks. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be the owner of the livestock injured or killed by wild animals.
benefits: Compensation Amounts: - Dairy animals (cow, buffalo, camel): ₹30,000 - Sheep/Goat: ₹3,000 - Non-dairy animals (bull, buffalo, camel, horse): ₹25,000 - Young animals (calf of cow/buffalo/horse/camel), Donkey/Mule: ₹16,000 - Pig: ₹3,000 Injury Compensation: - 50% of the amount payable for injury under revenue circular provisions. Mode of Disbursement: - Compensation is paid directly to the beneficiary via e-payment. Expected Time of Disbursement: - Compensation is provided within 30 working days of claim verification.

title: Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy)
description: The scheme aims to increase milk production and promote improved livestock breeding by providing two Murrah buffaloes to eligible farmers on a subsidy basis. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Sehore, Vidisha, or Raisen district, where the scheme is currently implemented. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer. 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Schedule Caste, or Schedule Tribe category. 1. The applicant must have basic infrastructure for maintaining two dairy animals, such as a shed and water availability.
benefits: Subsidy Process: - General Category: 50% subsidy and 50% beneficiary contribution. - Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Scheduled Caste farmers: 75% subsidy and 25% beneficiary contribution. - Provision of 2 Murrah Buffaloes with high genetic quality, each yielding 8–10 liters of milk daily. - Pregnant buffaloes (5 months or more) are provided to ensure immediate milk production.

title: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Kamdhenu Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide business opportunities in the dairy sector especially to unemployed youths, increase milk production, strengthen economic condition and farmers will get economic benefits even in adverse circumstances. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be at least 21 years of age. - The applicant must be a livestock farmer. - The applicant belongs to all categories: SC, ST, and others are eligible to apply. - The applicant must possess a minimum of 3.5 acres of agricultural land per unit (25 cattle). - The applicant can apply for up to 8 units, with land requirement increasing proportionately. - The applicant’s family’s collective landholding can be considered; in such cases, there will be co-borrowers. - For scattered landholdings, at least half an acre must be in one location. - The applicant must hold a training certificate from a reputed institute/organization in dairy management.
benefits: Loan will be disbursed in four stages (Amount in Lakhs) Stages of PaymentTime PeriodComponent DescriptionIndigenous Breed (₹ in Lakh)Crossbred/Hybrid/ Buffalo (₹ in Lakh)First installment1st MonthShed Construction11,00,00011,40,000Second installment4th MonthAnimal Purchase + Insurance + Transport9,00,00011,00,000Third installment10th MonthAnimal Purchase + Insurance + Transport8,00,0009,80,000First installment18th MonthAnimal Purchase + Insurance + Transport8,00,0009,80,000Total 36,00,00042,00,000 - Financial assistance for the construction of cattle sheds, the purchase of high-yielding milch cattle, cattle insurance, and transportation costs. - Each unit consists of 25 cattle (either all crossbred cows, indigenous cows, or buffaloes of similar breeds). - A beneficiary can avail up to 8 units (200 cattle) depending on landholding and repayment record. - Loan amount ranges from…

title: Flower Development (Demonstration)
description: The scheme aims to promote flower cultivation through demonstrations of major flowers like rose, tuberose, and marigold by providing financial assistance to farmers. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: - Exhibition: Demonstrations of major flowers such as rose, tuberose, aster, marigold, chrysanthemum, and gladiolus are conducted in farmers’ fields over an area of 0.04 hectares (400 square meters). - Financial Assistance: A subsidy is provided at the rate of 75% or a maximum of ₹3,000/- per demonstration, whichever is less, based on ₹4,000/- per demonstration for seeds, plants, bulbs, or suckers.

title: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of 'Electric Vehicles' to Consumers in State of Goa
description: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy for the purchase or conversion of Electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and four-wheelers, along with scrapping incentives for old vehicles, incentives for local manufacturing in Goa, and low-cost loans provided by CESL. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Goa. - The applicant must be the registered owner of the Electric Vehicle for which the Purchase Incentive is claimed. - The applicant must ensure the vehicle is an Electric Two Wheeler, Three Wheeler, or Four Wheeler purchased or converted in the State of Goa. - The applicant must purchase the Electric Vehicle from Convergence Energy Services Limited to avail of their low-cost loans and financial incentives.
benefits: State Subsidy (Quantum of Subsidy per kilowatt-hour) - Financial Year 2021-2022: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2022-2023: ₹8,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2023-2024: ₹6,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2024-2025: ₹4,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2025-2026: ₹2,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers. Capping of State Subsidy (Maximum amounts) - Two Wheeler: Not exceeding ₹30,000/- (for a maximum of 3,000 vehicles). - Three Wheeler: Not exceeding ₹60,000/- (for a maximum of 50 vehicles). - Four Wheeler: Not exceeding ₹3,00,000/- (for a maximum of 300 vehicles). Scrapping…

title: Skill Development Programme- Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to enhance the employability and entrepreneurial skills of students, researchers, and farmers in the field of biotechnology, thereby promoting self-employment and entrepreneurship in emerging areas of the biotechnology sector. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a graduate or postgraduate student, researcher, or farmer from subjects such as Biotechnology, Microbiology, Molecular and Genetic Biology, Environmental Biology, B.Tech in Biotechnology, or related fields.
benefits: Training programs are organized to promote self-employment under the Skill Development in Critical Areas of Biotechnology. These programs range in duration from 30/45 to 90 days for undergraduate and postgraduate students, and 180 days (Dissertation Program) for postgraduate students. During the training period, selected students conduct their research and practical training in the Council’s modern research laboratories. The trainees receive hands-on training in plant tissue culture, molecular biology and genetic engineering, environmental biotechnology, hydroponics, and soilless farming. After receiving the training, beneficiaries are better able to manage their business, self-employment, and agricultural activities.

title: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide crop insurance protection to farmers against weather-related risks under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana. It ensures financial support to farmers affected by adverse weather conditions. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: - Insurance Coverage for Crops: Provides protection to crops against losses caused by adverse weather conditions such as high or low temperatures, excess or deficient rainfall, and wind speed.

title: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Multiplication Programme
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
description: The scheme aims to enhance the economic status and productivity of SC/ST farmers by providing high-quality Breeder or Certified I grade seeds for seed production. Beneficiaries receive a 75% subsidy on the cost of the seed for up to 1 hectare of land. Eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer. Criteria Specific to "Seed Production Programme" - The applicant must be willing to participate in the Seed Production Programme. - The applicant's land must fall within the 10 km perimeter of the selected Government Agricultural Farms. - The applicant must conduct the program in a minimum area of 1/2 acre (0.2 hectare). - The maximum area for which subsidy is eligible is 1 hectare. - The applicant must mandatorily register with the Seed Certification Agency. Crops Included - Kharif crops - Paddy, Jowar, Bajra, Maize, Kodo, Kutki, Ragi. - Rabi crops - Wheat, Barley. Operational Area The program is implemented within the 10 kilometer perimeter of 46 specified Government Agricultural Farms. These farms are located across various districts, including Bhind, Gwalior, Datia, Shivpuri, Raipur, Rajnandgaon, Raigarh, Janjgir, Korba, Satna, Sidhi, Damoh, Chhatarpur, Panna, Seoni, Balaghat, Chhindwara, Narsinghpur, Katni, Umaria, Khargone, Dewas, Shajapur, Ratlam, Mandsaur, Bhopal, Sehore, Raisen, Betul, Rajgarh, Jagdalpur, Kanker, Sitapur, Koriya, Mandla, Shahdol, Dhar, and Jhabua.
benefits: - Provision of Breeder or Certified I Grade Seeds for seed production. - A 75% subsidy is provided on the Breeder or Certified Seed. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum area of 1 hectare. - The payment of registration fees required by the Seed Certification Agency, including the application fee, registration fee, inspection fee, and sample fee, is covered from the scheme funds. Conditions - The produced seeds must be made available to other Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe farmers under the scheme at a fair price in the subsequent year. - An agreement (Anubandh) must be executed between the department and the beneficiary through the Seed Production Committee or Farm Superintendent to ensure seed production, marketing (muktjan), and payment according to policy. - The entire agricultural methodology (Sampuurna Krishi Kaaryamaala) must be adopted for higher production. -…

title: Scheme for Promotion of Protected Cultivation of Commercial Horticultural Crops
description: The scheme aims to promote the protected cultivation of commercial horticultural crops by providing financial assistance to farmers. The scheme supports greenhouse, shade net, low tunnel, plastic mulching, bird/hail net, and cultivation of vegetables and flowers under polyhouse/shade net house. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: Eligible farmers are provided a subsidy up to a maximum of 50% of the unit cost.

title: Integrated Vegetable Development Program
description: The scheme aims to increase vegetable production in all district headquarters and within a 20 km radius of industrial establishments in Madhya Pradesh through integrated vegetable development. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the General/ Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe category.
benefits: - For General Category Farmers: Financial assistance of ₹1,500/- per hectare, including ₹1,400/- for hybrid/improved seeds and ₹100/- for seed treatment medicine. - For Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Farmers: Financial assistance of ₹2,250/- per hectare, including ₹2,100/- for hybrid/improved seeds and ₹150/- for seed treatment medicine.

title: Gomantak Govsamvardhan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to support the conservation and rearing of Local Breeds of Cattle in the State of Goa. It provides financial assistance of ₹80/- per animal per day to Dairy Farmers or Individuals who are bonafide residents of Goa to encourage responsible stall feeding and conservation practices. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a Dairy Farmer or an Individual of the State of Goa. - The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Goa for at least the preceding 15 years. - The applicant must own non-descript cattle or Shwet Kapila cattle. - The applicant must have an adequate cattle shed as per the Bureau of Indian Standard. - The scheme shall be applicable to rural areas and Class C and B Municipalities. - The applicant must be responsible for fulfilling the Pollution Control Board norms if the number of cattle reared exceeds 25 in number. If the number of applications received for rearing are more than 250 cattle per district, priority can be decided based on the grazing area of the beneficiary. Reservation - Out of the 250 cattle per district, 12% shall be reserved for the Scheduled Tribes (ST). - Out of the 250 cattle per district, 2% shall be reserved for the Scheduled Castes (SC) respectively. - In case there is no demand in the reserved categories, the demand shall be booked under the general component.
benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹80/- per animal per day. - This assistance covers the cost of maintenance of Local Breed Cattle, which includes feed, fodder, and other miscellaneous costs, bundled together in one component. - Microchipping or ear tagging of the cattle will be done by the area Assistant Director, Veterinary Officer, or Veterinary Assistant of the Veterinary Hospital/Dispensary sub-centres under the instruction of the Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer. - The subsidy will be credited in the account of the beneficiary. - Financial assistance will be provided on a quarterly basis. - The area Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer shall visit the cattle shed every month and submit the quarterly report (as per Annexure “A”) for the release of the subsidy. Benefit Limitations - The Scheme will be limited for a maximum of total 05 Local Breed Cattle per family. - The…

title: Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
ministry: Herbal Research And Development Institute, Mandal-Gopeshwar Chamoli, Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to simplify the sale process of medicinal and aromatic products produced by cultivators, enabling them to legally and easily sell their produce through authorized markets or buyers. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a cultivator producing medicinal and aromatic plants on measured land. - The applicant must be legally cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants on the measured land.
benefits: This policy has been formulated with the objective of simplifying the sale of medicinal and aromatic products produced through cultivation. Farmers can sell the medicinal and aromatic products grown on their own agricultural land to markets operated by the Forest Department or to any other buyer. This arrangement has simplified the marketing process of medicinal and aromatic plant products produced through cultivation.

title: Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA - Centre for Aromatic Plants
ministry: Centre For Aromatic Plants, Selaqui, Dehradun
description: The scheme aims to encourage farmers in rural areas to grow aromatic plants by providing them free planting material, technical help, and wage support through MGNREGA. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in a rural area of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be interested in aromatic plant cultivation. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years.
benefits: - Under MGNREGA, when aromatic cultivation is undertaken, the wages for the work done by the labourers in land preparation and related activities are paid by the Rural Development Department, and the farmer does not have to pay the wages. - The Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP) provides free planting material along with technical support, consultancy, and monitoring services to the farmers.

title: Bee Keeping
description: The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxes, bee colonies, and training support to farmers, thereby increasing honey production, enhancing farm income, and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in beekeeping.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Bee families (bees, including the queen bee) and bee colonies (bee boxes) are provided with a 40% subsidy (maximum cost per bee box is ₹2,000/- and per bee colony is ₹2,000/-). 50 bee boxes are provided in plain areas and 25 in hilly areas. - For example, if a bee box and bee colony cost ₹200/-, the farmer has to deposit ₹120/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre. The government bears a subsidy of ₹80/-, and the farmer receives the box for ₹120/-. - If a farmer wishes to keep bee colonies in their own orchards, financial assistance of ₹350/- per bee colony is provided. - If a farmer wants to receive training, the department provides a free seven-day beekeeping training program. Along with the training, the farmer is given ₹100/- per day (totaling ₹700/-) and ₹50/- per day (totaling ₹350/-). A total of ₹1,050/- is provided to each beneficiary.

title: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
description: The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual belonging to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category and residing in the mountainous or plain areas of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be interested in, or currently engaged in, fish farming or fish production. 1. The applicant (individual or group) must own or lease land and have a nearby water source within the state. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Pond clusters, comprising a minimum of 10 ponds at one location, are created for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. The scheme provides 60% of the total cost as a grant for pond construction and the first-year investment, including expenses on fish hatcheries and feed. A minimum of 10 ponds will be constructed in each village. - Individual beneficiaries are eligible to receive a grant for a maximum of 500 cubic meters, up to ₹3,00,000/-. For societies, groups, mahasanghs, federations, or mangal dals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, a grant of ₹5,10,000/- is provided, which constitutes 60% of the total project cost of ₹8,50,000/- for the construction of a 1-hectare pond in the plains. - Ponds of sizes ranging from 0.05 to 0.50 hectares will be constructed in the plains under this scheme.

title: Sthaniya Fasal Protsahan Karyakram
description: The program aims to promote the cultivation of local crops, enhance productivity, ensure the use of quality seeds, and provide fair prices to farmers in the mountain districts of Uttarakhand. Eligibility: - All farmers from the mountain districts of Uttarakhand are eligible.
benefits: Under the scheme, the following objectives will be achieved by distributing verified seeds of local crops at 100% subsidy: a. Distribution of certified seeds on subsidy to increase the cultivation area according to the specific region. b. Ensuring the recommended seed replacement rate is met. c. Enhancing production and productivity through the use of quality seeds. d. Promoting and encouraging the cultivation of local pulse crops. e. Ensuring farmers receive a fair price for their produce. Seed production will be carried out by the Agriculture Department in clusters formed under the Traditional Agriculture Development Scheme, through the CLF/LC established under UGVS-REAP, and directly by the Agriculture Department. For crops where traditional clusters are not operational, clusters will be identified through CLF/LC for certified seed production. The Agriculture Department will conduct…

title: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme
description: The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity & improve sugar recovery by promoting cultivation of high-quality, high-yielding, & newly developed sugarcane varieties, while providing farmers with financial support, modern cultivation techniques, & access to advanced agricultural technology. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicant’s name must be registered in the land records of the state.
benefits: 1. Sugarcane Seed Modification and Varietal Balance: A plan has been prepared to replace sugarcane varieties that have been cultivated for a long time and are currently grown (such as Ko.Sha.-767, Ko.-1148, Ko.Sha.-97264, Ko.Sha.-94257, and Ko.Sha.-8436, etc.) with better quality, high-yielding, and certified varieties. Newly developed quality sugarcane varieties include Ko.Pant. 12221, Ko.Sha. 8272, Ko. 0118, Ko.P.K. 5191, Ko. 15023, Ko.P.B. 91, Ko.P.B. 92, Ko.P.B. 96, Ko.P.B. 98, Ko. 13035, Ko.LKH. 9709, Ko.LKH. 12207, Ko.LKH. 14201, Ko.Sha. 13235, Ko.LKH. 15201, and Ko.LKH. 16202, etc. For low-lying areas, these high-yielding varieties should be cultivated in sufficient quantities to increase the success rate of sugarcane cultivation and enhance sugar recovery in mills. Sugarcane seed from research centers attracts a 20% premium over the government-declared sugarcane price. Farmers…

title: Bhed Palan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to promote sheep rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a sheep unit. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant must be included in the SECC (Socio-Economic and Caste Census) category. 1. The applicant should have an interest in sheep rearing.
benefits: - Self-employment in sheep rearing is facilitated by providing beneficiaries with a sheep rearing unit comprising 10 female sheep and 1 male sheep for a period of 10 to 14 months. - The total cost of the unit is ₹70,000/-, of which 90% (₹63,000/-) is funded by the State Government, and the remaining 10% (₹7,000/-) is contributed by the beneficiary.

title: Animal Husbandry: Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to small and marginal farmers for the replacement of productive livestock lost due to notified natural disasters such as floods, landslides, or other calamities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Small or Marginal Farmer from Uttarakhand who has lost their milk, agricultural, or haulage animals due to a notified natural disaster.
benefits: Replacement of Milk, Agricultural, and Transport Animals: - Milch animals: ₹37,500/- per animal (Buffalo/Cow/Camel/Yak/Mithun) will be payable.- ₹4,000/- per animal (Sheep/Goat/Pig) will be payable. Agricultural and Haulage Animals: - ₹32,000/- per animal (Camel/Horse/Bullock) will be payable. - ₹20,000/- per animal (Calf/Donkey/Pony/Mule) will be payable. Poultry Farming: - ₹100/- per bird, up to a limit of ₹10,000/- per beneficiary family. The death of birds must be due to a notified natural disaster to be eligible for assistance.

title: Mushroom Production
description: The scheme aims to promote and support mushroom cultivation in the state by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing mushroom, compost, and spawn production units, thereby enhancing both farmer income and overall mushroom production in Uttarakhand. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom production. 1. The farmer must either own land or have land on lease. 1. Each farmer is eligible for assistance for only one unit. 1. There is no provision to provide assistance or subsidy if the farmer does not take a loan.
benefits: Under the scheme: - To promote mushroom production, a 40% subsidy is provided to the individual sector (farmers or persons interested in mushroom cultivation). - For setting up a mushroom production unit, a 40% subsidy is provided, up to a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- per unit. - For setting up a compost production unit, a 40% subsidy is provided, up to a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- per unit. - For setting up a spawn production unit, a 40% subsidy is provided, up to a maximum of ₹15,00,000/- per unit. - For the public sector (government departments, institutions, agricultural/industrial universities, etc.), 100% subsidy is provided on the total cost.

title: Scheme for Fencing in Gardens
description: The scheme aims to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals by providing financial assistance for fencing. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.
benefits: The scheme provides financial support for fencing gardens to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals, offering a subsidy of 50% of the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹1.00 lakh per hectare.

title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Cage Culture - Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment through reservoir-based inland fisheries. It offers financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe fishermen. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private units, etc., involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
benefits: Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost of ₹3,00,000/- to ₹1,80,000/-, or 60% of the actual cost, whichever is less. Minimum Time Limit for Reclaiming Benefits: 3 year from the date of availing benefit.

title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing by Women - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to increase fish production through inland fisheries and provide employment opportunities, particularly to Scheduled Tribe women engaged in fish seed rearing. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an Individual woman involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary fisherwoman must have her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation: The scheme is specifically targeted at Scheduled Tribe women.
benefits: - The ₹90/- will be paid per 1,000 numbers, with a minimum 30% recovery for spawn to fry. - The rearing time for fish seed is 30 days. - Minimum 1 year required before reclaiming benefits under this component again.

title: Assistance to OBM Boat Owner Fishermen on Purchase of Kerosene/Petrol
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fishermen owning small boats with Outboard Motors (OBM) by subsidizing the cost of kerosene or petrol. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a fisherman. 1. The applicant must be a Kerosene Card holder. 1. The applicant must own a small boat operated by an Outboard Motor (OBM).
benefits: Assistance under the scheme: Name of Component Standard of Assistance Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits Assistance on the purchase of Kerosene/Petrol Maximum assistance of ₹50/- per literBenefits are available as per the prescribed quota throughout the year.

title: Meghalaya Agriculture Warehouse Scheme
ministry: Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department
description: The scheme reduces post-harvest losses and supports farmers by providing loans and subsidies to build small, weatherproof warehouses for safe storage and better marketing of crops. Eligibility: For Individuals: 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should have ownership of the land where the warehouse is proposed or leased land for at least the next 10 years. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter of any bank. For Registered Entities: 1. The applicant should be based in the village where the program is being availed. 1. The applicant should have an active bank account and submit the bank statement of the last six months. 1. The applicant should have been in operation for at least two years. 1. The applicant should possess land, either self-owned or leased, duly verified by the competent authority. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter of any bank.
benefits: 1. 5% of project cost to be contributed by the entrepreneur 75% of project cost provided upfront by Government of Meghalaya as margin money support to the bank remaining 20% via bank loan. 1. Direct credit linkage with partner banks. 1. Guidance and handholding in the application process through implementing agencies. 1. Support in project realization for the warehouse venture. 1. Training and capacity building for entrepreneurs to manage post-harvest storage effectively. 1. Technical support for maintenance and operations of warehouses.

title: FOCUS Scheme (Farmers Collectivization For Upscaling Production and Marketing System)
description: The objective of the FOCUS Scheme is to strengthen farmer groups, increase production, and improve market access to enhance farmers’ income. Eligibility: 1. The Producer Group must consist of 10 to 20 producers from the same village. 1. The members must be engaged in the same or similar agricultural or allied activities with high income-generation potential. 1. The group must formally form a Producer Group (PG) under the scheme. 1. Each member must hold a valid Family ID/Citizen ID of Meghalaya. 1. All members must belong to different households. 1. Each member must have a separate and unique Family ID of Meghalaya.
benefits: 1. The subsidy is disbursed through approved financing partners. 1. Loans are provided by selected partner banks with a repayment period of up to 15 years. 1. There are no pre-closure penalties on the loan. 1. The Government of Meghalaya pays 80% of the total project cost upfront. 1. The remaining 20% is provided as a bank loan (5% paid by the entrepreneur and 75% by the government). 1. Agriculture and Agri-allied Producer Groups (PGs) receive an annual cash benefit ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000.

title: Construction of Water Storage Tanks for Drip Irrigation
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers across Gujarat for constructing water storage tanks to support drip irrigation, with cost-sharing benefits based on farmer category. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must plan to construct a cemented water storage tank of at least 25.50 cubic meters capacity. Note: Cemented mature water tanks, drip set mandatory.
benefits: - Unit cost of construction: ₹1,00,000/- per tank. - For General category farmers: 50% subsidy, up to ₹50,000/-. - For SC/ST farmers: 75% subsidy, up to ₹75,000/-.

title: Assistance to Farmers in Purchasing Nano Fertilizers Under the Agricultural Assistance Program for Farmers Other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: This scheme offers financial assistance to farmers from non-SC/ST categories to support the purchase of Nano Fertilizers, aiming to enhance agricultural productivity and uplift the standard of living of farmers in Gujarat. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must belong to the General category (i.e., not SC or ST). - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: - Up to 50% of the purchased price per hectare or ₹750/- (within a maximum limit of 4 hectares per account.

title: Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP): Electrification of Wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers
description: The scheme aims to provide agricultural electricity connections on a priority basis to Scheduled Caste farmers. Benefits include electrification of wells and free domestic electricity connections for Scheduled Caste farmers and beneficiaries across Gujarat. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be from a Scheduled Caste.
benefits: Electrification of agriculture wells of the farmer.

title: National Gopal Ratna Award
description: The scheme aims to promote scientific dairy practices and AI coverage. It provides awards, recognition, and monetary incentives to farmers, dairy organizations, and AI technicians. Eligibility: 1. For Dairy Farmers - The applicant should be maintaining recognised indigenous breeds. - The applicant should be maintaining breeds out of 53 cattle breeds or 20 buffalo breeds. 1. For Dairy Cooperative Societies / FPO / MPC - The applicant organisation should be engaged in dairy activities. - The applicant should be registered under the Cooperative Societies Act or the Companies Act. - The applicant should be operating at the village level. - The applicant should collect at least 100 litres of milk per day and have at least 50 farmer members (for Non-NER states). - The applicant should collect at least 20 litres of milk per day and have at least 20 farmer members (for NER states). 1. For Artificial Insemination Technicians (AIT) - The applicant should be associated with State/UT Livestock Development Boards, Milk Federations, NGOs, or private organisations. - The applicant should have completed a minimum of 90 days of AI training.
benefits: 1. The National Gopal Ratna Award 2025 will be conferred to 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and one special Award for the North Eastern Region(NER) states in each of the above 3 categories. It will consist of a Certificate of merit, a memento and a monetary prize in the first two categories, i.e., Best Dairy Farmer and Best DCS/FPO/MPCs, as under: - ₹ 5,00,000/- (Rupee five lakh only) - 1st rank - ₹ 3,00,000/- (Rupee three lakh only) - 2nd rank - ₹ 2,00,000/- (Rupee two lakh only) - 3rd rank - ₹ 2,00,000/- (Rupee two lakh only) -Special Award for North Eastern Region (NER) and Himalayan States (Uttarakhand, J&K, Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh). 1. title: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation
description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation" aims to improve the productivity and quality of coffee by facilitating the creation of infrastructure for water augmentation for irrigation and wet processing of coffee. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a tribal grower. 1. The applicant should not have received a subsidy for Water Augmentation during the XII plan period. 1. The land records must be in the beneficiary's name. 1. These records should be certified by the Village Authority/State Government/Competent Authority. Eligible Activities Installation of the water storage tank, open well, and irrigation equipment (sprinkler/drip) to enhance production, productivity, and quality. Location Specifications - Water storage tank construction can be above or below ground level. - Water augmentation structures must be on the estate or within its vicinity.
benefits: Subsidy Details - The eligible subsidy for water harvesting structures and sprinkler units is 75% of the unit cost, capped at a maximum ceiling of ₹1,25,000 for all related activities combined. - For below-ground water storage tanks, the subsidy is based on the lower value between dimension and unit cost applicable to the size of the holding. - For above-ground water storage tanks, the subsidy is based on the lower value between the actual cost or the unit cost applicable to the below-ground water tank. Subsidy Availability Growers can claim subsidies for water harvesting structures and irrigation equipment either simultaneously or at different times. title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production:Large Cardamom Replanting/New planting (Ha)
description: Under this scheme, growers are encouraged to adopt systematic replanting of large cardamom using high-yielding, disease-free planting materials. It aims to increase productivity, improve quality, and enhance export competitiveness under the Spices Board of India. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal grower owning up to 8 hectares of land. 1. The applicant should belong to the SC/ST category. 1. The applicant should undertake replanting/new planting in a minimum contiguous area of 0.10 Ha. 1. The applicant should not exceed 8.00 Ha total eligibility, and should avail subsidy for a maximum of 4.00 Ha per financial year in a phased manner. 1. The applicant should be cultivating in eligible regions such as Sikkim, Darjeeling, Kalimpong, and other North Eastern states. 1. The applicant should ensure a minimum plant population of 4000 plants per hectare with spacing of 5 × 5 feet. 1. The applicant should allow inspection by designated officials, and assistance will be granted only after approval. 1. The applicant should avail second-time assistance for the same area only after 8 years, except in cases like natural calamities.
benefits: 1. 33.33% of cost of cultivation of large cardamom subject to a maximum of ₹ 33,600/- per Ha for General Category and 75% of cost of cultivation ₹ 75,000/- per Ha for SC/ST payable in two annual installments of ₹ 16,800/- and 37,500/-, respectively. 1. Small and marginal growers owing up to 8.00 Ha. The minimum area to be replanted / new planted contiguously under the scheme is 0.10 Ha Maximum area eligibility per grower is 8.00 Ha but at a time i.e., in a financial year a grower can avail subsidy only up to 4.00 Ha as replanting has to be carried out in a phased manner.

title: Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme
ministry: Department Of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government Of Meghalaya
description: The scheme “Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to provide Small Commercial Vehicles and pickups at each CD Block across Meghalaya with 50% financial aid from the Government of Meghalaya. Eligibility: Individuals 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a valid commercial driving license. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must be involved in the agriculture sector for at least two years. 1. A certification letter from the Block Development Officer (BDO) is required as proof of agricultural involvement. 1. The applicant should not be a loan defaulter with any bank. Registered Entities 1. The applicant must be a registered entity such as a Cooperative, Farmer Producer Company (FPC), or Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) under the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity must be engaged in the agriculture sector for at least two years. 1. A certification letter from the Block Development Officer (BDO) must be provided as proof of agricultural involvement. 1. The entity should not have availed benefits under the first phase of the PRIME Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme. 1. The applicant must submit an Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate, as applicable. 1. At least two members of the entity must have a training certificate in the relevant sector from a recognized institution (preferably a government institute). 1. The entity should not be a loan defaulter with any bank. Unregistered Entities 1. Any unregistered entity such as village organizations, self-help groups, producer groups, or other traditional institutions based in Meghalaya can apply. 1. The entity must be involved in the agriculture sector for at least two years. 1. A certification letter from the Block Development Officer (BDO) must be provided as proof. 1. The entity should not be a defaulter with any financial institution. 1. The entity should not have availed benefits under the first phase of the PRIME Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme.
benefits: 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicant, 45% by Government of Meghalaya) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks (MRB, MCAB, SBI, SCUB) 1. Additional 3% annual interest subvention on reefer trucks with Aadhaar linkage 1. Pre-fitted GPS device with 5-year warranty 1. Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government 1. Capacity building and training programs by Department,1917iTeams 1. Market linkage through 1917iTeams with live vehicle tracking 1. Eligibility for various vehicle types, including reefer trucks for perishable goods transportation

title: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
ministry: IPL Centre For Rural Outreach (ICRO) Established Under The Indian Potash Limited (IPL)
description: The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially, renewable up to four times. Eligibility: 1. The applicant for the internship should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be 12th Pass / Diploma Holder / Graduate or in the Final Year of their graduation degree. 1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-45 years. Reservation/Preference/Priority Preference will be given to candidates having agriculture or related sector qualification.
benefits: STIPEND - The selected intern shall be entitled to ₹ 6,000/- per month as a stipend during the period of internship. CERTIFICATE - The interns will be issued an Internship Completion Certificate upon successful completion of the internship. NOTE: No payment towards transportation and other allowance etc. shall be paid to the interns.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / water storage structures(nos)
description: The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a grower of large cardamom located in Sikkim, Darjeeling, and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern States. 1. The applicant should undertake irrigation or water storage construction activities only in permissible areas, ensuring that such constructions do not block the natural flow of water, including streams, and are not objectionable to the local community or concerned authorities. 1. The applicant should ensure that the proposed work complies with all local regulations and environmental norms. 1. The applicant should submit the application for inspection by the designated officials, who will conduct a final inspection and recommend only eligible cases for assistance. 1. The applicant should allow verification by the Inspecting Officer, who must confirm that all conditions are fulfilled and no violations exist before recommending the case for sanction.
benefits: 1. 50 % of cost of construction subject to a maximum of ₹30,000 per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹45,000/- per unit for SC/ST. 1. The minimum capacity of irrigation structure should be 25 cubic meter for availing maximum subsidy under the program. Any farmer who has availed this benefit earlier is not eligible to avail the benefit. 1. Large cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha are eligible to avail this scheme.

title: Establishment Of Small Scale Dairy Unit (SSDU)
description: The scheme aims to support the establishment of dairy units with 10 Gir cows. Through this scheme, capital subsidy and back-ended subsidy are provided to beneficiaries via bank finance and NABARD. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Daman and Diu and Dadra and Nagar Haveli. 1. The applicant should establish a small-scale dairy unit with 10 milch cows. 1. The applicant should procure indigenous Gir breed cows only. 1. The applicant should avail a bank loan for implementation of the project. 1. The applicant should utilise the subsidy strictly for approved components. 1. The applicant should maintain records as per the General Financial Rules, 1963. Preference / Reservation / Relaxation: The applicant belonging to the Scheduled Caste or the Scheduled Tribe category is eligible for a higher subsidy rate under the back-ended subsidy and insurance components.

title: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of Lakadong turmeric (Ha)
description: To promote the cultivation of Lakadong turmeric for exports by providing 50% of the cost of planting material, subject to a maximum of ₹ 30,000 per Ha, to turmeric growers of the North East having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha. Eligibility: 1. The applicable to turmeric growers in Sikkim, Darjeeling & Kalimpong district of West Bengal, and other North Eastern States. 1. Eligible cases will be finalized based on inspection and recommendation by designated officials.
benefits: 1. 50% of cost of planting material subject to maximum of ₹ 30,000 per Ha 1. Turmeric growers of NE having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha

title: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
ministry: National Bank For Agriculture And Rural Development (NABARD)
description: A welfare scheme by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare was launched in 2002. AC&ABC aims at agricultural development, supplementing the efforts of public extension by providing extension and other services to farmers either on a payment basis or free of cost as per the business model. Eligibility: 1. The age of the applicant must be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant must qualify as one of the following - - Graduates in agriculture and allied subjects from SAUs/ Central Agricultural Universities/ Universities recognized by ICAR/ UGC. Degree in Agriculture and allied subjects offered by other agencies are also considered subject to the approval of the Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, Government of India on the recommendation of the State Government. - Diploma (with at least 50% marks)/ Post Graduate Diploma holders in Agriculture and allied subjects from State Agricultural Universities, State Agriculture and Allied Departments, and State Department of Technical Education. - Diplomas in Agriculture and allied subjects offered by other agencies are also considered subject to the approval of the Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, Government of India on the recommendation of the State Government. - Biological Science Graduates with Post Graduation in Agriculture & allied subjects. - Degree courses recognized by UGC have more than 60 percent of the course content in Agriculture and allied subjects. - Diploma/Post-graduate Diploma courses with more than 60 percent of course content in Agriculture and allied subjects, after B.Sc. with Biological Sciences, from recognized colleges and universities. - Agriculture-related courses at intermediate (i.e. plus two) level, with at least 55% marks.
benefits: - 44% of the project cost will be as a composite subsidy for women, SC/ST & all categories of candidates from NE and Hill states and 36% of the project cost for all others. - Graduates from agriculture studies background will be given free of cost training if they wish to set-up centers. - National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE) will be responsible for providing training to eligible candidates, through Nodal Training Institutes (NTIs) and motivating them for setting up of Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centers. - Ceiling of project cost for subsidy is ₹20,00,000/- for an individual project (₹25,00,000/- in case of extremely successful individual projects) and up to ₹100 lakhs for a group project (established by a group comprising at least 5 trained persons under the scheme). - The scheme tends to promote better farmina methods and to suprment and…

title: Scheme for Loan and Subsidy for Manure and Fertilizer-DNH&DD
description: The scheme aims to promote fertiliser use for higher productivity. Subsidy-cum-loan assistance is provided in kind to small and marginal farmers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a cultivator or farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to categories such as Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), or original farmers (as mentioned). 1. The applicant should have a land holding of up to 2 hectares. 1. The applicant should be engaged in agricultural activities requiring fertilisers or manure.
benefits: 1. Provision of Manure and Fertilizers - Manures and fertilizers will be provided to eligible cultivators. - Assistance is given in kind and not in cash. 1. Subsidy and Loan Component - Assistance is provided on a 40% subsidy and 60% loan basis. 1. Crop-wise Fertilizer Quantity (in Nutrients) - Paddy: Nitrogen 110, Phosphorus 60, Potash 60 - Maize: Nitrogen 100, Phosphorus 50 - Groundnut: Nitrogen 25, Phosphorus 50 - Castor: Nitrogen 20, Phosphorus 20 - Wheat: Nitrogen 100, Phosphorus 50, Potash 50 - Sugarcane: Nitrogen 250, Phosphorus 125, Potash 125 1. Green Manuring Support - 40 kg of seeds per hectare will be supplied for green manuring. 1. Loan Recovery Provision - The loan amount shall be recovered in one instalment after completion of the season. 1.
