benefits: Under this scheme, an annual insurance coverage is provided as follows: - ₹5,00,000/- in case of accidental death or total permanent disability. - ₹2,50,000/- for partial disability (such as loss of limbs, fingers, or partial loss of vision/hearing/speech, etc.). - ₹50,000/- for hospitalization expenses due to accidents. - The fish farmer is not required to pay any insurance premium. The entire premium amount is borne by the Department.

title: Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to crops, livestock, or agricultural land caused by fire, flood, or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a minimum of 18 years of age to submit and receive a claim.
benefits: Damage caused by fire accidents to standing crops, harvested crops in the field, crops stored in barns for threshing, or residual produce in the notified market areas of Uttarakhand State, as well as damage to property and livestock due to fire in the farmer’s house, and damage to agricultural land due to floods or rain-induced soil erosion, all such losses make farmers eligible to receive compensation under this scheme.

title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana
description: The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR/SCP to bear all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs, and to ensure the continuous operation of the ice plant/cold storage. 1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided based on the actual cost, within the overall ceiling specified under the relevant PMMSY sub-components. 1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant must either own the project land or hold it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years to be eligible.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹120,00,000/- Subsidy Distribution : 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana
description: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The construction of new ponds subsidy will be provided by the state government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme. 1. Only central financial assistance will be provided to the beneficiaries for the initial fish crop only on the fertiliser of newly constructed ponds. 1. Central financial assistance on the construction of new ponds will be provided only on ponds prepared for fisheries. 1. Under this scheme, ponds whose pond duration will be for a long time, and the registered lease period will be at least 7 years, will be considered for a grant on those ponds.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹8,00,000/- per hectare. - The subsidy is limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Kiosks Including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental Fish-Haryana
description: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the construction of fish kiosks, including those for aquarium/ornamental fish. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should submit an undertaking in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)/Self Contained Proposal (SCP) to the effect that all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by them. 1. The applicant should ensure the fish kiosk will be kept in operational condition for 10 years. 1. The applicant should display a board permanently at the infrastructure facilities to the effect that the fish kiosk is constructed with Central Assistance under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY). 1. The applicant can only avail of central assistance for one unit. 1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/ agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.
benefits: The project cost is ₹10,00,000/- per unit. Subsidy of 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries. Subsidy of 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana
description: The scheme under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for freshwater aquaculture in newly constructed ponds to expand fisheries production in Haryana. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana with a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant will be eligible for input cost subsidy provided by the State Government only for the expansion of fisheries in urban or semi-urban areas under the construction of new ponds. 1. The applicant will receive central financial assistance only for the initial fish crop (fertilizer) in newly constructed ponds. 1. The applicant will be eligible for central financial assistance on input costs only if the pond is properly prepared for fisheries. 1. The applicant may use land on a long-term registered lease, provided the lease period is at least 7 years, for eligibility under this scheme.
benefits: - The project cost is: 4,00,000/- per hectare Subsidy Distribution: 1. 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries 1. 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries

title: PMMSY: Construction of New Grow Out Ponds - Haryana
description: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas through the construction of new grow-out ponds. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for the construction of new grow-out ponds to beneficiaries who are engaged in fisheries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The construction of new grow-out ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new grow-out ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme. 1. Central financial assistance for the construction of new grow-out ponds will be provided only for the ponds prepared for fisheries. 1. The applicant should have own land with clear title or having land on a long-term registered lease, not less than a minimum of 7 years.
benefits: - The scheme provides financial assistance for the Construction of the New Grow-out Ponds. The project cost is ₹7,00,000/- per Hectare. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries falling under the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries who are Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women.

title: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 2nd Year to 5th Year Lease Money
description: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their economic status by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - 40% of the actual lease amount OR ₹40,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary. Note: Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Small Biofloc Establishment Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to increase inland fish production and generate employment through innovative fish farming techniques like Biofloc and RAS. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: Small Biofloc Establishment (7 tanks 4mm diameter and 1.5m height): Financial Assistance: - The unit cost is ₹7,50,000/- per unit. - General Category: 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less. - Women/Scheduled Caste (S.C.) and Scheduled Tribe (S.T.) Categories: 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less. Mode of Disbursement: Assistance is paid through 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments. Validity: The benefit for small biofloc establishment can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.

title: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Reinforced Area Development
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Reinforced Area Development" aims to promote sustainable agriculture through improved agronomic practices, efficient resource use, and integrated farming systems by providing financial support to all farmers. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer.
benefits: - Financial Help: Provides financial assistance to eligible farmers to adopt sustainable agricultural practices. - Improved Agronomic Practices: Encourages the implementation of location-specific, modern, and efficient farming techniques. - Soil Health Management: Supports initiatives for maintaining and enhancing soil fertility and health. - Enhanced Rainwater Use Efficiency: Promotes techniques and infrastructure for optimal utilization of rainwater in agriculture. - Judicious Use of Chemicals: Advocates for reduced and responsible application of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. - Crop Diversification: Encourages farmers to cultivate a variety of crops, promoting resilience and better income opportunities. - Integrated Farming Systems: Supports the adoption of integrated crop-livestock-tree farming for holistic farm management.

title: Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The "Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5" aims to enhance the skills of women through training on value addition, preservation, and kitchen gardening of horticultural produce, while also providing a daily stipend and training support. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be willing to participate in horticulture-related skill development training.
benefits: - Stipend: ₹500/- per trainee per day sanctioned as training expenditure. Out of this, ₹250/- is provided as a direct stipend to the trainee, and ₹250/- is utilized for material cost, training literature kit, and honorarium to resource persons. - Skill Development Training: Training duration ranges from 2 to 5 days. Modules include fruit and vegetable preservation, canning, kitchen gardening, and value addition.

title: Assistance for Protected Cultivation
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme “Assistance for Protected Cultivation” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote protected horticulture practices by providing financial assistance to farmers for mulching, plug nursery, polyhouse, shed net house, and nursery development. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer.
benefits: Plastic Cover (Mulching): - General Area: ₹32,000/- per hectare. - Hilly Area: ₹36,800/- per hectare. - 50% of the expenditure incurred, limited to 1 hectare per beneficiary. - Self-Employment Oriented Horticulture Nursery Development Programme: - Nursery Structure: ₹3,50,000/- per unit - ₹3,00,000/- per unit for 500 sq.m. area - Starter Kit: ₹50,000/- per unit - Assistance up to 65% of the cost or ₹2,27,500/-, whichever is less. Shed Net House & Polyhouse: - Coverage: 500 sq.m to 4,000 sq.m - Assistance as per square meter cost based on empanelled company prices - Structures supported: Cylindrical, bamboo, and wooden. Plug Nursery: - Public sector: ₹30,00,000/- per hectare for 1 hectare - Private sector: Assistance of 50% or ₹15,00,000/- per hectare (whichever is less) for 1 hectare.

title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Agricultural Fair/Exhibition/Farmer Camp Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to improve the agricultural productivity and the livelihood of Adivasi farmers. It provides hybrid seeds, fertilizers, equipment, and support for agricultural fairs. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
benefits: The assistance is provided with a limit of ₹1,00,000/- can be spent for holding Agricultural Fair/Exhibition at the Taluka level. Farmer Shibir for 100 farmers, ₹15000/- can be spent within the limit. Remarks: Literature, tea, refreshments, meals, traveling expenses, exhibition stall fee, mandap, banner, photographs, sound system, electricity, furniture rent, Vs. Can be spent on things.

title: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Replanting of Old Oil Palm Garden
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme component "Replanting of Old Oil Palm Garden" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to enhance oil palm production and lower dependency on imports by supporting farmers in uprooting and replanting old oil palm gardens. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: Subsidy: ₹250/- per plant (uprooting, replacing, and digging of new pit).

title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Pump Set (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to improve agricultural productivity and livelihood. It provides subsidized pump sets and farm inputs to Scheduled Tribe farmers (except Dang district). Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
benefits: Subsidy on oil engines: - 3.0 to 3.5 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹8,700/- (whichever is less).- 5.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹12,000/- (whichever is less).- 7.5 to 8.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹13,500/- (whichever is less).- 10.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹13,875/- (whichever is less). Subsidy on electric motors: - 1.0 to 3.0 H.P.: 75% of purchase price or ₹8,600/- (whichever is less).- 5.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹9,750/- (whichever is less).- 7.5 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹12,900/- (whichever is less). Subsidy on submersible pump sets: - 3.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹15,750/- (whichever is less).- 5.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹22,350/- (whichever is less).- 7.5 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹27,975/- (whichever is less).- 10.0 H.Pa.: 75% of purchase price or ₹33,525/- (whichever is less). Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit can…

title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Power Operated Plant Protection Equipment Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to help farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
benefits: 1. The assistance provided is 75% of the purchase price of power/machine-driven equipment or ₹ 4500/- whichever is less. (Maximum one unit per account is allowed.) Remark: As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35) Frequency: Once in 3 Years.

title: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Harvesting Tools
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme component "Harvesting Tools" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm and reduce its import by providing subsidies for various harvesting tools to farmers in the state. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: - Cutter: ₹2,500/- per unit.- Wire Mesh: ₹20,000/- per unit.- Motorized Chisel: ₹15,000/- per unit.- Portable Ladder/Polls: ₹5,000/- per unit.- Chaff Cutter: ₹50,000/- per unit.- Tractor Trolley: ₹2,00,000/- per unit.

title: PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles. Through this scheme, subsidy benefits are provided to general, women, and SC/ST category beneficiaries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. Preference/Reservation/Relaxation: - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
benefits: 1. The unit cost of a refrigerated vehicle is ₹25,00,000/-. 1. 40% assistance (up to ₹10,00,000/-) is provided for general category beneficiaries. 1. 60% assistance (up to ₹15,00,000/-) is provided for women and SC/ST category beneficiaries. Conditions: - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India. - The benefit is available once in a lifetime. Mode of Disbursement: Contribution is shared: 60% by the Government of India and 40% by State Governments. Frequency of Disbursement: One-time assistance. Validity: Once in a lifetime for eligible beneficiaries.

title: Investment Grant for Farmers with More than 2 Hectares of Agricultural Land
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers owning more than 2 hectares of agricultural land who suffer crop losses due to natural disasters. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident farmer of Uttarakhand engaged in agricultural activities within the state. 1. The financial assistance will be applicable only for the area actually sown with crops.
benefits: Under this scheme: 1. ₹8,500/- per hectare for unirrigated areas. 1. ₹17,000/- per hectare for areas with assured irrigation. 1. ₹22,500/- per hectare for all types of evergreen crops. In cases where crop damage exceeds 33%, assistance will be provided only up to a maximum limit of 2 hectares per farmer.

title: Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide short term catalytic support to the District Administration in backward districts to improve programme delivery and simultaneously develop a cadre of Development Facilitators. Fellows receive professional experience, structured learning, and a monthly stipend. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a citizen of India. - The applicant's age must be between 22 years and 27 years at the time of application. - The applicant must hold at least a graduate degree from a recognized University with a four-year degree course. - The applicant must hold a post-graduate degree from a recognized University in case the graduate degree course duration was less than four years. - The applicant's one-year post graduate course will also be considered valid for eligibility if it is regular, full time, and if the degree/equivalent diploma is recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education/Medical Council of India/University Grants Commission. - The applicant must have achieved at least 50% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade at the graduate or Post-graduate level, whichever is qualifying. - The applicant must possess physical fitness, certified by Government Medical Hospital, for the arduous nature of the work. - The maximum age limit will be 32 years for candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe category. Other Conditions Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes. Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Tribes.
benefits: Stipend Package - The Fellow shall be entitled to a consolidated stipend package of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) per month during the orientation period. - The Fellow shall be entitled to ₹75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) per month during the first year of the Fellowship (post-orientation). - The Fellow shall receive a 10% increment during the second year, subject to satisfactory performance. - This package is deemed to cover the Fellow’s honorarium, boarding and lodging expenses during orientation, accommodation/house rent during the rest of the Fellowship period, health insurance, life and disability insurance cover, and any other contingency expenses. - Travel reimbursement will be based on actual costs and restricted to AC-II tier train fare by the shortest route or equivalent, plus local transport cost. Women Fellows with children below five years are allowed…

title: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to owners of domestic animals who suffer losses due to attacks by wild animals in forest areas and their surroundings. Under this scheme, a grant ranging from ₹3,000 to ₹40,000 per animal is provided, depending on the species and extent of loss. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The compensation is applicable only for the loss of domestic animals caused by any of the following wild animals: - Tiger - Leopard - Snow Leopard - All three species of Bear - Hyena - Wild Boar - Crocodile/Gharial - Snake
benefits: At present, the following compensation amounts are provided in case of animal loss due to attacks by wild animals: Type of Animal Loss Total Payable Amount Share of State Disaster Response Fund Share of Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund Milch Animals- Buffalo / Cow / Camel / Yak / Mithun etc. (Per Animal)₹30,000/-₹30,000/----Agricultural and Transport Animals – Camel, Horse (per Animal)₹40,000/-₹25,000/-₹15,000/-Mule (per Animal)₹40,000/-₹16,000/-₹24,000/-Bull (per Animal)₹25,000/-₹25,000/----Heifer/Donkey/Pony (per Animal)₹16,000/-₹16,000/----Sheep/Goat/Pig (per Animal)₹3,000/-₹3,000/----

title: Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)
description: The scheme aims to provide short-term working capital loans for livestock activities by offering eligible livestock farmers interest-subsidized loans for operational purposes through banks. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a member of a primary agricultural credit cooperative society. 1. The applicant should require short-term working capital for livestock activities, including dairy production.
benefits: - Short-term working capital loan for livestock activities through the Kisan Credit Card system. - Interest subsidy is provided on loans sanctioned under the scheme. - Expected Time of Disbursement: Typically within 15 days of application approval.

title: Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals
description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to victims or families affected by wild animal attacks in both urban and rural areas through timely monetary compensation. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a victim of a wild animal attack, resulting in injury or death. 1. The applicant should submit proof that the injury or death was caused by a wild animal (excluding snakes, monitor lizards, and other poisonous creatures). 1. In the case of death, the applicant must be a legal heir, family member, or relative of the deceased person.
benefits: Compensation Amount: - In case of death: ₹4,00,000 is paid to the deceased’s legal heir or family member after deducting any temporary assistance already given and the actual cost of medical treatment before death.- In case of injury: Actual medical expenses are reimbursed, along with ₹500 per day (maximum ₹50,000) if hospitalized, after deducting any temporary assistance already provided. Expected Time of Disbursement: - Within 3 working days in case of death. - Within 7 working days in case of injury. Mode of Disbursement: - The payment is made directly to the beneficiary’s bank account via e-payment.

title: Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products
description: The scheme aims to increase the storage capacity of perishable products by providing grant assistance for cold storage facilities. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: - Grant Assistance: A grant of 50% of the project cost up to a maximum of ₹2,00,00,000/- for cold storage facilities up to 5,000 metric tons capacity.

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers - Uttarakhand
description: Under this scheme, individual large farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, self-help groups, and custom hiring centres in the state can purchase agricultural equipment at a subsidized rate, with the Government of India providing a maximum subsidy of 40%. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a large farmer (owning 5 hectares or more of land), a cooperative group, self-help group, or a custom hiring centre in Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer or group must have cultivable land located in Uttarakhand. 1. For an individual large farmer, their name must be recorded in the revenue records. For a group, the names of all group members must be listed in the agricultural land documents.
benefits: Under the Custom Hiring Centre component (for groups of farmers involved in buying, renting, or selling agricultural equipment), farmer groups, cooperatives, FPOs, self-help groups, and individual farmers can purchase equipment valued between ₹10.00 lakh and ₹100.00 lakh. The Government of India provides a maximum subsidy of 40% on such purchases.

title: Bari (Kitchen Garden) Scheme
description: The scheme aims to promote kitchen gardening among poor and small/marginal farmers and agricultural laborers living below the poverty line by providing free vegetable seed packets. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer/agricultural laborer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Below the Poverty Line (BPL) category.
benefits: Free Vegetable Seed Packets: Each eligible beneficiary receives a packet of vegetable seeds worth ₹75 free of cost.

title: Exhibition Fair and Publicity
description: The scheme aims to promote departmental schemes and disseminate information about the technology of fruit, flower, vegetable, and spice crops to farmers through exhibitions and seminars organized at the district and block levels. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: - Awareness Creation: Farmers receive knowledge about horticulture schemes and technologies related to fruit, flower, vegetable, and spice crops. - Scheme Promotion: Departmental schemes are publicized to ensure more participation and benefit utilization among farmers.

title: Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide for the management of tree covered areas located on private land and revenue land under the MP Public Forestry Act, 2001. The scheme benefits landowners, Gram Panchayats, or Gram Sabhas by allowing them to undertake the scientific management of their tree covered areas. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a landowner who desires to take responsibility for the management of any tree covered area. - The applicant must be a Gram Panchayat or a Gram Sabha who desires to take responsibility for the management of any tree covered revenue land located within its jurisdiction. - The applicant must apply to the Tehsildar (Revenue) for the demarcation and management of the land as "Lok Van" (Public Forest), if the land is tree covered revenue land. - The applicant must submit the management proposal to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) or the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari). - The applicant (Landowner) must attach a declaration regarding land title/possession, including an attested photocopy of the latest land records (Khasra). - The applicant (Gram Panchayat/Gram Sabha) must submit a resolution to the Tehsildar (Revenue) after getting the land demarcated and handed over for management as "Lok Van".
benefits: - Authorization for scientific management of tree-covered areas. Conditions - The designated Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must implement the Technical Management Plan according to the activities and conditions specified within the plan. - For "Lok Van" (Public Forest) management plans, the Gram Sabha must authorize the implementation of the specified activities through a resolution of the Social Audit Committee. - If the management plan involves harvesting timber, the concerned Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must provide advance notification regarding the proposed date of harvesting to the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari) or Tehsildar, at least seven days prior to the proposed date. - The Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must maintain a register regarding the trees harvested, using the prescribed format within the Technical Management Plan. - All…

title: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Exchange Programme
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
description: The scheme aims to increase agricultural productivity and production for SC/ST farmers who cannot afford improved seeds. It provides high-yielding improved seed varieties, up to one hectare, in exchange for existing crop or seed, backed by a 75% subsidy with a maximum limit of ₹1,500/-. Eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer. - The applicant must be unable to afford the purchase of improved varieties of high-yielding foodgrain crops. Post-Selection Conditions - The farmer must exchange their existing crop or seed for the improved seeds.
benefits: - Provision of improved seeds of high-yielding varieties of foodgrain crops. - 75% subsidy on the actual price of the seed provided in exchange. - The maximum limit of the subsidy is ₹1,500/-. - Seeds of suitable varieties for the land and area will be provided in equal quantity compared to the seed provided by the farmer. - The provision is limited to a maximum area of one hectare. - Certified seed will be provided. Conditions - The seeds supplied must be of the improved variety, prioritizing those that are suitable for or prevalent in the area. - If certified seed is scarce, or depending on the specific crop condition, true form seed may be distributed only with the permission of the Director of Agriculture. - If the farmer provides seed of a different crop for exchange, the seed given by the farmer must be worth 25% of the actual price of the certified seed of the requested crop. -…

title: Assistance Towards Sugarcane Supplied By The Sugarcane Growers
description: The scheme aims to assist Sugarcane Growers to take up sugarcane cultivation in the State of Goa. It provides financial support to farmers cultivating sugarcane, paid based on actual tonnage supplied at the factory weighbridge as per the Fair & Remunerative Price. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be cultivating sugarcane in Goa. - The applicant must possess a valid Krishi Card issued by the Directorate of Agriculture. - The applicant must ensure the sugarcane area is verified by the representatives of the Zonal Agriculture Office of the respective Taluka, along with the Fieldman of Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL). - The applicant must be issued an area certificate following verification of the sugarcane area. - The applicant must be present for the inspection of the harvested cane by the Fieldman of Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL) or any representative of the Agriculture Department.
benefits: - Financial assistance is provided based on the Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) fixed by the National Federation of Co-operative Sugar Factories Limited, New Delhi, from time to time. - Farmers will be paid based on the actual tonnage of canes weighed at the Sugar factory weighbridge. Conditions - The farmers must harvest and supply the sugarcane on their own to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL). - The harvested cane must be loaded and brought to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana, Dayanandnagar Dharbandora by the farmer on his own cost. - The farmer must duly sign the GAR 32 form, which is used in the submission process by Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana to the Zonal Agricultural Office. - The Government or Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana will not take any responsibility to harvest and transport the sugarcane.

title: Mukhyamantri Krishak Mitra Yojana
description: The scheme aims to create necessary infrastructure by the distribution company for providing permanent pump connections to farmers or groups of farmers. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a landholding farmer/group-farmer.
benefits: - Cost Sharing Support: Only 50% of the infrastructure development cost will be borne by the concerned farmer or group of farmers. - Government Grant: 40% of the cost will be provided directly by the State Government to the power distribution company as a grant.

title: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Production Programme
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
description: The scheme aims to enhance the production and economic status of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe small and marginal farmers. It provides Foundation or Certified Grade I seeds for high-yielding food grain crops with a 75% subsidy to registered farmers operating near Government agricultural farms. Eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer. - The applicant must be willing to participate in the “Seed Production Programme”. - The applicant must operate within the 10-kilometer periphery of the selected Government agricultural farms. - The applicant must conduct the program on a minimum area of 0.2 hectares (1/2 acre). - The applicant must be eligible for a maximum grant up to 1 hectare. - The applicant must mandatorily register with the Seed Certification Agency. - The plan includes the food grain crops Paddy (Dhan), Jowar, Bajra, Maize, Kodo, Kutki, Ragi (for Kharif), and Wheat (Gehu), Barley (Jau) (for Rabi). Preference should be given to the names listed first in the approved list. The waiting list will remain valid only until the crop season. Implementation Area The Seed Production Programme will be implemented within the 10-kilometer periphery of the following Government agricultural farms: Gohad (Bhind), Mahuakheda (Gwalior), Indergarh (Datia), Gazaura (Shivpuri), Rannod (Shivpuri), Gariyaband (Raipur), Khairibilari (Raipur), Mohgaon (Durg), Surgi (Rajnandgaon), Bhavarmara (Rajnandgaon), Amethi (Raigarh), Ragja (Janjgir), Lakhanpur (Korba), Gehwara (Satna), Samda (Sidhi), Jabera (Damoh), Naogaon (Chhatarpur), Ajaygarh (Panna), Bhomakhatiya (Seoni), Kinhi (Balaghat), Delakhedi (Chhindwara), Narsinghpur (Narsinghpur), Pirprod (Katni), Manpur (Umariya), Bhikangaon (Khargone), Chandrakeshar (Dewas), Girwar (Shajapur), Panched (Ratlam), Patan (Mandsaur), Phanda (Bhopal), Rehthi (Sehore), Silwani (Raisen), Gundgaon (Betul), Sarangpur (Rajgarh), Keralapal (Jagdalpur), Kanker (Kanker), Pankhajor (Kanker), Chalta (Sitapur Surguja), Lohari (Koriya), Ori (Mandla), Biridodogari (Mandla), Birhuliya (Shahdol), Nogaon (Dhar), Jobat (Jhabua), Alirajpur (Jhabua), Garhi (Balaghat).
benefits: - Provision of Foundation or Certified Grade I seeds of improved varieties of high-yielding food grain crops for seed production. - Eligibility for a 75% subsidy on the actual cost of the Foundation or Certified seed up to a maximum area of 1 hectare. - Payment for registration (application fee, registration fee, inspection fee, and sample fee) with the Seed Certification Agency will be covered from the scheme budget. - Technical training and necessary information will be provided by the Rural Agricultural Extension Officer, Senior Agricultural Development Officer, and Subject Matter Specialist (Sub-Divisional level). - Guaranteed procurement of the produced seed by the Seed Production Committee or Farm Superintendent at government-fixed rates. - Expenditure related to the grading, processing, stocking, and packing of raw seeds produced on Government agricultural farms can be carried…

title: Livestock Mission Scheme - Interest Payment on Loan
description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities at the local level by encouraging livestock-based entrepreneurship and reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries through payment of 90% of the bank loan interest by the State Government. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an interested livestock farmer. 1. The livestock farmer must be eligible to avail a bank loan.
benefits: For promoting self-employment at the local level, 90% of the interest subsidy on the bank loan taken by the applicant for setting up the following units is borne by the State Government: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme: - 5 cow units - 10 cow units - 2 buffalo units - 5 buffalo units Load Carrier Entrepreneurship Development Scheme: - 1 mule unit - 2 mule unit Sheep and Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme: - Sheep/Goat (5 female + 1 male) - Sheep/Goat (10 female + 1 male) Pig Entrepreneurship Development Scheme: - Pig (5 female + 1 male) - Pig (10 female + 1 male) Poultry Entrepreneurship Development Scheme: - Commercial broiler farm for 1,000 birds - Small commercial layer farm for 250 birds

title: District Plan - Sugarcane Development Scheme
description: The scheme aims to enhance sugarcane productivity & quality in Uttarakhand by providing financial & technical support to farmers for improved seed production, seed & soil treatment, pest & disease management, thereby promoting sustainable farming & strengthening the livelihoods of sugarcane growers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicant’s name must be registered in the land records of the state.
benefits: 1. Scheme for Improved Sugarcane Seed Production: A subsidy of ₹1,000/- per hectare (₹2,000/- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for established/base nurseries, and ₹500/- per hectare (₹1,000/- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for primary nurseries. 1. Seed/Soil Treatment: A 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for chemicals used in seed and soil treatment. Of this, 25% is contributed by the government, while the remaining 25% is shared equally by the Sugarcane Development Council and the sugar mill. 1. Sugarcane Stalk Base (Pedi) Management Program: To protect ratoon sugarcane crops from pests and diseases, a 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for pesticides used in pest and disease control. The subsidy comprises 25% contribution from the government, with the remaining 25% shared by the Sugarcane Development Council and the sugar mill.

title: Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers - Centre for Aromatic Plants
ministry: Centre For Aromatic Plants, Selaqui, Dehradun
description: The registration ensures that farmers are eligible to access the benefits of all schemes offered by CAP, including state and central government subsidies, technical guidance, training programs, and product clearance support. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The farmer must be engaged in aromatic plant cultivation.
benefits: - Registration of farmers with the Aromatic Plant Centre (CAP) is mandatory to avail of the benefits of all the schemes run by the Aromatic Plant Centre. - After registration, CAP provides farmers with facilities such as subsidies provided by the State and Central Governments, technical information, training, product clearance, etc.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote growth of fisheries sector by providing financial assistance & technical support for modern fisheries activities, thereby increasing fish production,improving livelihood opportunities,& encouraging adoption of advanced fisheries infrastructure among eligible beneficiaries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman. 1. The applicant must have availability of land and a water supply source.
benefits: A 60% subsidy is provided to SC/ST and Women beneficiaries for pond construction, trout units, rearing units, RAS, biofloc units, cage culture, cold storage, motorcycles with ice boxes, fish kiosks, ornamental fisheries, feed mills, hatcheries, and similar activities. A 40% subsidy is provided for all other categories, and a 20% subsidy is provided specifically for large RAS units. Table-1: Activity/Item Unit Cost per Hectare Grant (General Category) Grant (Women/SC/ST) Maximum Limit/Grant Limit Construction and investment of new ponds₹11 lakh (per hectare)₹4,40,000/-₹6,60,000/-Maximum 2 hectares individual & 20 hectares society/group etc. Trout Raceways and Investment (Nos.) 50 sq.m. per unit₹5,50,000/-₹2,20,000/-₹3,30,000/-Maximum 4 units individual & 20 units society/group etc.Large RAS (8 tanks)/Large Biofloc Unit (50 tanks)₹50,00,000/-₹10,00,000/-₹12,50,000/-Maximum 1…

title: Drip Irrigation Sprinkler
description: The scheme aims to promote efficient and sustainable irrigation for horticultural crops by providing farmers with modern irrigation systems and financial subsidies to enhance productivity and water conservation. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
benefits: Irrigation systems are established to provide irrigation facilities through drip irrigation, portable sprinklers, micro sprinklers, mini sprinklers, or rain guns, as per the requirements of new plants. Under this scheme, a 45 to 55% subsidy is payable for areas ranging from 4 hectares up to a maximum of 5 hectares. An additional 25% subsidy is provided to state farmers as a top-up.

title: Tubewell Installation /Pond Construction
description: The scheme aims to enhance irrigation facilities for farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance for the construction of tubewells and ponds, thereby improving water availability, supporting horticultural development, and increasing agricultural productivity. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The farmer must confirm the availability of water in the concerned area. 1. A farmer is eligible for a subsidy for the construction of one tube well/pond.
benefits: Under this scheme, to promote the development of irrigation facilities, farmers are provided a 50% subsidy on the total cost for the construction of new tubewells or ponds, up to a maximum of ₹90,000/- per unit (limited to one unit per farmer).

title: Minimum Support Price for Aromatic Oils/Products - Centre for Aromatic Plants
ministry: Centre For Aromatic Plants, Selaqui, Dehradun
description: The scheme aims to provide registered farmers engaged in aromatic cultivation with a fair price and a guaranteed market for their produce. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be engaged in the cultivation of aromatic plants. 1. The farmer must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun.
benefits: - Farmers can sell 25 varieties of aromatic oils/products at the prescribed price to the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP). - Farmers are ensured a fair price and a guaranteed market for the aromatic oils they produce.

title: State Millet Mission
description: The mission aims to promote millet cultivation, ensure fair prices for farmers, and strengthen food security in the state. It seeks to support farmers, particularly in mountain districts, by procuring millet crops such as Mandua and Jhangora at the minimum support price through cooperative groups. Eligibility: 1. All farmers from the mountain districts of Uttarakhand are eligible.
benefits: - Under the mission, in the first phase, 16,820 metric tonnes of Mandua and Jhangora are being purchased from farmers’ fields at the minimum support price through cooperative groups by the Cooperative Department. - Under the National Food Security Act, the Government of India will distribute 1 kilogram per month through the Public Distribution System (ration card) via the Food and Supplies Department in four districts: Udham Singh Nagar, Haridwar, Nainital, and Dehradun. Farmers’ groups, LCs/LCFs, or PACS at established procurement centers are free to offer Mandua for sale. To encourage participation, an incentive of ₹150/- per quintal is provided. - Once the PACS accepts the millet crops from the groups, payment will be made through RTGS/NEFT within a maximum of 72 hours.

title: Allotment of Shops in Kisan Bazaar
description: The scheme aims to facilitate trade in products other than agricultural produce by providing commercial shops in Kisan Bazaars. The shops are allotted to eligible residents of Uttarakhand through public notices published in newspapers and displayed at public places. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: The scheme facilitates trade in products other than agricultural produce by allotting shops in the Kisan Bazaars to eligible residents of Uttarakhand.

title: Mahila Dairy Vikas Pariyojana - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to empower rural women in Uttarakhand by promoting their active participation in the dairy sector through Women Milk Producers Cooperative Societies, enhancing milk production, and providing training, incentives, and awareness programs for sustainable livelihood development. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman interested in the milk procurement business sector.
benefits: - Under this scheme, by providing adequate resources to rural women through Women Milk Producers Cooperative Societies at the village level, their direct participation in the state’s economy is encouraged, making them socially and economically self-reliant. - The scheme also organizes various training, incentive, and awareness programs for women members to increase milk production. These include training programs for secretaries and management committee members, women encouragement and motivational programs, seminars on clean milk procurement, and special women-focused seminars on the occasion of International Women’s Day. - Under the women incentive program to increase milk procurement, first, second, and third prizes are awarded to the women milk producers who supply the maximum milk in the district.

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to encourage farm mechanization purchasing and providing 50% subsidy/financial assistance to SC/ST, small and marginal, and women farmers (of all categories), while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. SC/ST farmers, small and marginal farmers, and women farmers (of all castes) are eligible for 50% financial assistance under the scheme, while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers. 1. The name of the applicant farmer must be recorded in the revenue records of the cultivable land owned or cultivated by them.
benefits: Under the scheme, all farmers of the state are eligible to receive financial assistance for the purchase of modern agricultural equipment for farming. A 50% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to SC/ST, small and marginal, and women farmers (of all categories), while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers. The details are as follows: Sl. No. Name of Equipment Norms of subsidy as per SMAM for SC/ST/Small & Marginal and Women Farmers 1Power Tiller Below 8 BHP50% or maximum ₹65000/-, whichever is less.2Power Tiller 8 BHP and above50% or maximum ₹85000/-, whichever is less.3Power Weeder Power Driven Less than 2 BHP50% or maximum ₹25000/-, whichever is less.4Power Weeder Power Driven More than 2 BHP50% or maximum ₹35000/-, whichever is less.5Power Weeder Power Driven More than 5 BHP50% or maximum ₹63000/-, whichever is less.6Chaff Cutter (power/drawn…

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE)
description: The scheme aims to promote the adoption of modern and scientific farming practices among farmers across the state through continuous training, practical demonstrations, and exposure visits. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must have cultivable land. 1. The farmer’s name must be duly registered in the relevant land records.
benefits: Farmers are periodically trained in modern agricultural practices. Agricultural exhibitions, fairs, and farmer seminars are organized, and farmers are also taken on exposure visits to enhance their knowledge and skills. Additionally, farmer–scientist interactions are conducted to facilitate the exchange of ideas and innovations. Farm School: Free seeds, fertilizers, and chemicals are provided to farmers for demonstration purposes, and training is imparted to a group of 30 farmers at each Farm School. Progressive farmers who demonstrate excellence and innovation in agriculture are recognized and rewarded. Along with a certificate, the following cash awards are given: - Block Level: ₹10,000 – Kisan Shri - District Level: ₹25,000 – Kisan Bhushan - State Level: ₹50,000 – Kisan Ratna

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote & support organic farming among farmers in Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹9,000/- per hectare to farmers for the purchase of organic inputs, including seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, etc. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must own agricultural land within the state. 1. The farmer’s name must be recorded in the land revenue records.
benefits: This scheme promotes organic farming by providing farmers with an incentive of ₹9,000/- per hectare for purchasing organic inputs such as seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, PROM, Burmese compost, waste decomposers, and other materials required for organic farming.

title: Flower Area Expansion
description: The scheme aims to promote and expand flower cultivation by providing cultivators in Uttarakhand access to quality flower planting material at a subsidized cost, thereby increasing flower production and enhancing farmers’ income. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
benefits: To encourage flower production, flower planting material (bulbs, plants, and seeds) is provided to cultivators at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, applicable for a maximum area of 4 hectares, as follows: - For open flowers, planting material worth up to ₹20,000/- per hectare is provided. - For stalked flowers, planting material worth up to ₹50,000/- per hectare is provided. - For bulbous flowers, planting material worth up to ₹75,000/- per hectare is provided. (For example, if 1 kg of marigold seeds costs ₹200/-, the cultivator pays ₹100/- at the Horticulture Mobile team Center, while the government provides a subsidy of ₹100/-, allowing the cultivator to obtain the seeds for ₹100/-.)

title: Fruit Area Expansion
description: The scheme aims to increase fruit production by encouraging farmers to establish new orchards, providing fruit plants at a 50% subsidy to support the expansion of fruit cultivation across Uttarakhand. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. If the farmer owns land, the maximum land allowed per beneficiary is 4 hectares and the minimum land allowed is 0.02 hectares. 1. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 4 hectares.
benefits: - Increasing production by establishing new orchards. - Fruit plants are provided at a subsidy of 50% of the total cost. - For developing orchards, fruit plants such as mango, guava, pomegranate, apple, litchi, plum, peach, apricot, walnut, citrus, malta, kiwi, dragon fruit, etc., are provided to farmers. (For example, if a walnut plant costs ₹400/-, the farmer has to deposit ₹200/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre, and the government bears the remaining ₹200/- as subsidy, so the farmer receives the plant for ₹200/-.)

title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Training of Tribal Trainees - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to boost fish production and provide employment through inland fisheries. Under this scheme, Financial assistance is provided as a scholarship to tribal trainees undergoing fisheries training. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private units, etc., involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
benefits: A trainee is paid a scholarship of ₹2,000/- per month for three months, amounting to a total of ₹6,000/-. Training Details Duration: 3 months Location: Tribal area training centers run by the Fisheries Department at Khedbrahma, Kadana, Chhota Udepur, Rajpipla, Madhuban, and Ukai. Conditions for Receiving Benefits: A trainee is eligible for the scholarship only if they maintain a minimum of 60% attendance during the training period. Validity: The benefit is available once in a lifetime for each eligible trainee.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)
description: The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice Board, Department of Commerce and Industry, Ministry of Commerce. Eligibility: Individual growers/farmers groups having suitable land and facility for irrigating the nursery. Area of Operation Sikkim, Darjeeling & Kalimpong districts of West Bengal & other NE States. Modalities - Allotment of units will be multiples of 500 with a minimum of 1000 nos. to a maximum of 5000 nos. per beneficiary. - Farmers will start nursery follow-up visits will be conducted by the Field Staff and necessary technical guidance will be rendered for successful production of planting materials. - Planting materials produced in the nurseries will be used for replanting / gap filling by the applicants and the balance will be supplied to the neighbouring/needy farmers at an optimum price not exceeding the market price. Designated Officials will conduct final inspections and recommend the eligible cases.
benefits: - 33.33% of the cost of production of planting material subject to a maximum of ₹ 3 per seedling for the General Category. - 75% of the cost of production of planting material @ ₹ 6.75 per seedling for SC/ST. Time of Payment Payment of subsidy will be in the succeeding year of planting the mother suckers/ seeds for multiplication in the nursery and satisfactory production of suckers/seedlings. Mode of Payment Eligible assistance will be paid to beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) , except for specific cases like QGBG, weather-based insurance for cardamom (small), and distribution of polythene sheets.

title: Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme
description: The Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program includes Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme under the Planning Dept, Govt of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to employ, engage, and empower the youth and rural communities by promoting Dairy related entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies. Eligibility: Individuals 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The entrepreneur should possess land, either self-owned or on lease, verified by the competent authority. 1. The entrepreneur should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized Institution, preferably from a Government Institute. 1. The Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience of undertaking dairy. 1. The entrepreneur should have access to adequate and quality feed for the cattle. 1. The entrepreneur should have a vaccination Scheme in place for the cattle. 1. The entrepreneur should have a plan for marketing the dairy products. 1. The entrepreneurs village should be in an area where dairy farming is feasible. 1. The distance between the entrepreneur’s village and the nearest market must be reasonable. 1. The entrepreneur should not be a credit defaulter from any bank. Registered Entities 1. Any group/entity registered in Meghalaya such as Cooperatives, Farmer Producer Companies (FPC), Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) and so on 1. Must provide an Incorporation Certificate or a registration certificate whichever is applicable 1. At least two members should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized institution, preferably from a government institute 1. Should possess land, either self-owned or on lease, verified by the competent authority 1. Should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized Institution, preferably from a Government Institute 1. Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience of undertaking dairy. 1. The entrepreneur should have access to adequate and quality feed for the cattle 1. The entrepreneur should have a vaccination Scheme in place for the cattle. 1. The entrepreneur…
benefits: 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 24 months 1. Veterinary and farm management support 1. Mentorship and business advisory 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicant, 45% by Government) 1. Market linkage for selling output 1. Technical training and capacity building

title: Assistance in Packing Materials under Post Harvest Management of Horticultural Produce
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers to procure packing materials like corrugated and wooden boxes for post-harvest management of horticultural produce. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be engaged in horticultural cultivation.
benefits: 1. Unit Cost: ₹10,000/ha. 1. 75% of the cost or ₹7,500/hectare, whichever is less. Note: 1. Corrugated boxes, wooden boxes will be used as packing material. 1. Assistance will be available up to a maximum limit of 1 hectare per account. 1. Available on i-Khedut portal every year (once during the year),

title: Assistance Program for the Cultivation of Lotus Fruit (Dragon Fruit)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers to support the cultivation of dragon fruit (lotus fruit), with higher benefits for SC/ST and priority for small-scale and women farmers. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must have a minimum land between 0.20 ha and 1 ha. - The applicant must procure quality planting materials from a nursery and start the plantation. Note: Preference will be given to small-scale and women farmers.
benefits: - General category: 50% assistance or up to ₹3,00,000/- per hectare (whichever is less).- SC/ST category: 75% assistance or up to ₹4,50,000/- per hectare (whichever is less). First Year Assistance: - Cement pole/pipe: 1111 units at ₹300 each = ₹3,33,300/-- Planting material: 4444 units at ₹35 each = ₹1,55,540/-- Total: ₹4,88,840/-- Actual Assistance Provided: 50% or up to ₹2,44,420/-, whichever is less. Second Year Assistance: - Head ring or Trellising & wire (approx. 400 kg) : ₹1,11,160/-- Actual Assistance Provided: 50% or up to ₹55,580/-, whichever is less.

title: Assistance Program for Planting in Floriculture
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme offers financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for the cultivation of floriculture crops, including loose, cut, and tuberous flowers, based on crop type and farmer category. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be engaged in floriculture farming (loose, cut, or tuberous flowers).
benefits: Loose Flowers: - ₹16,000 per hectare or 40% of cost for small/ marginal farmers. - ₹10,000 per hectare or 25% of cost for other farmers. Stem (Cut) Flowers: - ₹40,000 per hectare or 40% of cost for small/ marginal farmers. - ₹25,000 per hectare or 25% of cost for other farmers. Tuberous Flowers: - ₹60,000/- per hectare or 40% of cost for small/ marginal farmers. - ₹37,500/- per hectare or 25% of cost for other farmers.

title: National Agriculture Insurance Scheme
description: The National Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS) was introduced by the Government of India to provide comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Eligibility: Loanee Farmers: 1. Farmers who avail seasonal agricultural operations (SAO) loans from financial institutions (banks, co-operative societies, etc.) are automatically covered under the scheme. 1. The coverage for loanee farmers is compulsory, and premiums are deducted from the loan amount. Non-Loanee Farmers: 1. Non-loanee farmers can apply voluntarily for the insurance coverage. 1. The application must be submitted before the deadline for each crop season. Notified Crops and Areas: 1. The crops to be insured and the areas where the scheme is applicable are announced by the government each year.
benefits: Comprehensive Crop Coverage: - Protection against crop loss due to natural calamities (floods, droughts, hailstorms), pests, diseases, and localized risks. - Includes coverage for sowing, standing crops, and post-harvest losses. Subsidized Premiums for Small Farmers: - Small and marginal farmers receive premium subsidies, making the scheme affordable for them. Affordable Premiums for All Farmers: - Low premium rates for both loanee and non-loanee farmers, with premiums deducted from agricultural loans. Quick Claim Settlement: - Fast processing and direct claim settlement to the farmer’s bank account. Encourages Better Farming Practices: - Promotes risk mitigation and adoption of modern agricultural practices, increasing productivity. Wide Crop Coverage: - Covers food crops, oilseeds, and horticultural crops, ensuring protection for most farmers. Nationwide Accessibility: - Available to…

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide old-age social security through a minimum assured monthly pension of ₹ 3,000/- to Small and Marginal Farmers after attaining the age of 60 years. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a Small or Marginal Farmer. 1. The applicant should have cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares as per State or Union Territory land records. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of entry. 1. The applicant’s name should appear in land records as on 01.08.2019. 1. The applicant should possess an Aadhaar card. 1. The applicant should have a savings bank account or PM-KISAN account.
benefits: - Monthly Pension Benefit: - The subscriber will receive a minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years. - Family Pension Benefit: - In case of death of the subscriber, the spouse will receive 50% of the pension amount as family pension. - Family pension is applicable only to the spouse. - Government Matching Contribution: - The Government of India will contribute an amount equal to the subscriber’s monthly contribution to the pension fund. - Disablement Benefit: - If the subscriber becomes permanently disabled before the age of 60 years, the spouse can continue the scheme by paying contributions or exit by receiving the subscriber’s contribution with interest. - Exit Benefits: - If the subscriber exits within 10 years, only the subscriber’s contribution will be refunded with savings bank interest. - If the subscriber exits after 10 years but before…

title: Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme
description: The scheme aims to support BPL Scheduled Tribe farmers in tribal areas by providing financial assistance to purchase rotavators and thresher machines. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a resident of tribal or forest areas of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer dependent on agriculture as the main source of livelihood. 1. The applicant should intend to use the machinery for self-employment and agricultural purposes.
benefits: - Financial assistance to farmers to purchase a rotavator (6 feet) or a thresher machine.

title: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards
description: The scheme "Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards" aims to facilitate the improvement of the quality of coffee produced by growers by encouraging them to establish infrastructure for quality enhancement and obtain certification for their coffees, enabling them to earn better returns. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a tribal grower. 1. The applicant should not have availed of the benefits during the XII plan.
benefits: Unit Cost and Scale of Subsidy Size of the Holding: Up to 2 hectares. Dimension of the Unit: 10 feet x 10 feet or (100 square feet). Unit Cost: ₹15,000/- Rate of Subsidy: 75% of unit cost. Size of the Holding: 2 hectares and above. Dimension of the Unit: 20 feet x 20 feet or (400 square feet). Unit Cost: ₹45,000/- Rate of Subsidy: 75% of unit cost.

title: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Tractor Purchase
ministry: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
description: The scheme offers a specialized loan for farmers to purchase tractors, covering up to 90% of the tractor's cost. Eligibility: 1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. 1. The beneficiary should be a farmer. 1. The beneficiary should be engaged in agriculture activities. 1. The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for purchasing Tractor.
benefits: - Access to Loan: Covers up to 90% of the tractor cost. - Interest Rate: 11% to 12.25% (subject to change).

title: Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)-DNH&DD
description: The scheme aims to help the families of the fishermen affected due to captured by Pakistani Marine Security Agency. Under this scheme, daily assistance, repatriation allowances, and vessel reconstruction subsidies are provided. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant must be a boat owner or fisherman captured by the Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA), or a family member thereof.
benefits: Pattern of Assistance: - Unskilled daily wages rate as notified time to time by the U. T. Administration to the families of the Fishermen those are held 1s time captive/detained by Pakistani Marine Security Agency (PMSA), having valid ID Cards and resident of U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. - T.A./D.A. to the fishermen during the repatriations from Pakistani Jail:- 1. Travelling Allowance (T.A.) is admissible at 2nd class Sleeper of Railways Fair. 1. Daily Allowance (D.A.) of ₹250/- per day per person is admissible during repatriation. - One time financial Assistance in the form of back ended subsidy to the registered boat owner of the U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to re-construct/ replace their fishing vessels by new fishing vessels @ 25% maximum up to ₹ 10.00 lakh, with waiting period of five years.

states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

title: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (nos)
description: The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a large cardamom grower located in Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern States. 1. The applicant should submit the application for consideration under the scheme in the prescribed format.
benefits: 1. 50 % of cost of equipment subject to a maximum of ₹ 15,000 for General and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 20,000/- for SC/ST 1. Large cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha

title: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rainwater harvesting structure(nos)
description: The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a large cardamom grower located in Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern States. 1. The applicant should undertake construction activities in a manner that does not block the natural flow of water, including streams, and is not objectionable to the local community or concerned authorities. 1. The applicant should ensure that the proposed rainwater harvesting or irrigation structure complies with all local regulations and environmental norms. 1. The applicant should allow inspection by designated officials, who will conduct the final inspection and recommend only eligible cases for assistance. 1. The applicant should ensure that the Inspecting Officer can verify that no violations of the prescribed conditions have occurred before recommending the case for sanction.
benefits: 1. 33.33 % of cost of construction subject to a maximum of ₹18,000 per structure for General and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 40,000 /- per structure for SC/ST 1. The above assistance will be for a structure of 200 cu. Mt. capacity lined with silpauline sheet. For lesser capacity the assistance will be limited proportionate to the water holding capacity. 1. Large cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha Devices can be for harvesting water from direct rainfall as well as surface run off without blocking the natural flow of water including streams.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: \Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting: For Kerala & Tamilnadu
description: Under this scheme to motivate growers to improve production and productivity through systematic replanting of diseased, old, and senile plantations, and to undertake area expansion. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to Kerala or Tamil Nadu and undertake Small Cardamom replanting/new planting activities under the scheme. 1. The plantation/site will be subject to final inspection by the Designated Officials, and only eligible cases recommended by them will be considered for assistance.
benefits: 1. 33.33% of cost of cultivation of subject to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- per Ha for General Category and 75% of cost of cultivation ₹2,10,000/- per Ha for SC/ST payable in two annual installments of ₹50,000/- and ₹1,05,000/- each year respectively. 1. Individual registered cardamom growers having a land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha. 1. Minimum area to be replanted under the programme is 0.10 Ha in a continuous block and the maximum area is limited to 2 Ha per beneficiary per year and a maximum of 8 Ha. in block year of 5 years from 2021-2026. 1. The plant population is minimum 1100 Nos. per ha. 1. Replanting cycle is considered as 8 years and a second time benefit for the same area replanted by a beneficiary will be available only on completion of 8 years except on exclusive circumstances like natural calamities, devastating pest and disease attacks certified by a committee…

title: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
description: The scheme aims to provide easy and affordable access to soil testing facilities at the village level and support rural youth through financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- for establishing Village Level Soil Testing Labs. Eligibility: - The Age of the applicant should be between 18 to 27 years - The Educational Qualification of the applicant should be 10th pass with science and knowledge of computer - The applicant / entrepreneur group should have their own premises / rented building with lease agreement for atleast four years.
benefits: - One-Time Financial Assistance: Financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- is provided for establishing a Village Level Soil Testing Lab (VLSTL). - Assistance for Soil Testing Equipment: Up to ₹1,00,000/- for soil testing equipment, reagents, sample shaker machine, and one-year Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC). - Assistance for Laboratory Consumables: Up to ₹50,000/- for distilled water, pH meter, conductivity meter, electronic balance, glassware, filter papers, and other required consumables. - Soil Testing Services: Provides affordable soil testing services to farmers at the village level. - Soil Health Advisory: Facilitates customized soil nutrient recommendations based on soil test results. - Agricultural Productivity Support: Helps farmers optimize fertilizer use and reduce input costs by avoiding under-application or over-application of fertilizers. - Awareness Generation: Promotes…

title: Agricultural Extension
ministry: National Institute Of Agricultural Extension Management
description: Extension Division endeavours towards successful implementation of Agricultural Extension activities.
