The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices. 1. The applicant must either own the land or have it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years. 1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided based on actual costs, within the overall ceiling limits specified under PMMSY sub-components. 1. The applicant must understand that, upon approval, the subsidy will be disbursed as per the procedure laid out under PMMSY.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹40,00,000/- Subsidy Distribution : 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition. 1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only motorcycle with ice box. 1. The applicant should utilize the vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities. 1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchase, operation, maintenance, and management of fish transport facilities.
benefits: Financial Assistance provided under the scheme: - Project Cost: ₹75,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
description: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must own land or hold a registered lease for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The applicant must submit an undertaking within the DPR/SCP, accepting full responsibility for operating and maintaining the unit. 1. The applicant must provide ice at affordable prices to fishers. 1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) in accordance with PMMSY guidelines. 1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate in ice plant or cold storage operation and maintenance. 1. The applicant must ensure the land is free from legal issues and must provide a valid land title.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹150,00,000/- Subsidy Distribution: 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
description: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY. Eligibility: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The Beneficiaries will submit an undertaking in the DPR to the effect that all operational, maintenance and post construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them and the Fish Feed Plant will be kept in operational condition. 1. Central assistance for Fish Feed Mill will be as per actual cost within the overall ceiling indicated in the respective sub-components/activities under PMMSY. 1. The Beneficiary will ensure supply of feed produced from the government assisted Fish Feed Plant to the fishers and fish farmers at affordable price. 1. The projects having land on long term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the registered lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.
benefits: Monetary Assistance: - Grant of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for establishing a fish feed mill with 20-ton/day capacity. Subsidy Provisions: - 40% subsidy on unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% subsidy on unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
description: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a fish farmer. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must ensure that the fish transportation facility is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant must not have availed a grant for a similar insulated (reefer) vehicle earlier.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Financial grant of up to ₹20,00,000/- per unit for the purchase of an insulated (reefer) vehicle. Grant Limits: - 40% of the unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - 60% of the unit cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries. Note - Subsidy is applicable for one vehicle per beneficiary only. - Central assistance is released only after initiating fishery activity. - The applicant should agree that any losses in procurement, operation, or maintenance are their own responsibility, and not that of the Government of India or Haryana.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant/beneficiary should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. All operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by the beneficiary. 1. The beneficiary should ensure that the Fish Feed Mill remains in functional condition. 1. The beneficiary should supply the feed produced from the government-assisted Fish Feed Mill/Plant to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant should either own the land or have it on a registered lease agreement valid for a minimum of 10 years.
benefits: Tangible Benefits: - Project Cost: ₹30,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage.Under this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided on insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insurance, helping them mitigate potential crop losses Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a farmer and involved in shrimp farming. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
benefits: - 50% subsidy on the insurance premium paid for shrimp crop insurance.

title: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 1st Year Lease Money
description: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and to uplift these families by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. The pond lease period should not be less than 5 years. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - 50% of the actual lease amount OR ₹50,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Large RAS Culture System Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance for various inland fisheries activities, including the establishment of large Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), and is provided to individuals, societies, self-help groups, associations, reservoir leaseholders, and private entities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: Assistance is provided for the establishment of a Large Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) with 8 tanks of a minimum 90 m3/tank capacity, targeting 40 tonnes/crop production. - The unit cost for this component is ₹50,00,000/- per unit. - For the General Category, the scale of assistance is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less. - For Women, Scheduled Castes (SC), and Scheduled Tribes (ST) categories, the scale of assistance is 60% of the unit cost or 60% of the actual cost, whichever is less. Mode of Disbursement: 60% of the government contribution is from the Government of India, and 40% is from the State Government. Frequency of Disbursement : The minimum time limit for reclaiming benefits is specified as "Once in a lifetime".

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Medium RAS Culture System Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to enhance fish production and create employment through sustainable inland fisheries. It provides financial support to eligible beneficiaries for setting up medium-scale RAS units. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: The scheme provides assistance for the establishment of a Medium Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) with 6 tanks of a minimum 30m3/tank capacity (10t/crop). Financial Assistance: - The unit cost for this component is ₹25,00,000/- per unit. - General Category: 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, is paid as subsidy. - Female/Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) Category: 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, is paid as subsidy. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit for the establishment of a Medium RAS (with 6 tanks of minimum 30m3/tank capacity 10t/crop) culture system (PMMSY) can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Back-Yard Mini RAS Unit Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to enhance inland fish production and create employment. It provides subsidies to eligible beneficiaries for fish hatchery and RAS unit establishment. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: The scheme provides assistance for the establishment of Back-Yard Mini Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) units. Financial Assistance: - The unit cost for this component is ₹50,000/- per unit. - General Category: 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, is paid as a subsidy.- Female/Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) Categories: 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, is paid as a subsidy. Mode of Disbursement: The assistance is paid with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government. Frequency of Disbursement: Once in a lifetime.

title: Sub mission on Seeds and Planting Material
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to increase the production of certified/quality seed; strengthen Seed Testing Laboratories; assist Seed Producing Institutes for the adoption of new technologies, ensuring farmers get quality seeds at the right time and reasonable prices. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: all categories of farmers, State Agricultural Universities (SAUs), Farmers' Producer Organisations (FPOs), Co-operative enterprises, or Government enterprises. 1. The applicant must attach land records along with the application form. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account.
benefits: Seed Village Programme: - Assistance will be provided for the distribution of foundation and certified seed required for a 1-acre area for cereal crops; the assistance covers 50% of the cost, and for pulse, oilseeds, green manure & fodder crops, the assistance covers 60% of the cost. - Validity: The maximum time limit for reclaiming benefits is 2 years. Strengthening of Seed Quality Control Laboratories: - Assistance is provided on a project basis. - Intended Use: For State Agricultural Universities (SAUs), Farmers' Producer Organisations (FPOs), Co-operative enterprises, and Government enterprises. - Frequency of Disbursement: One time. Creation of Seed Infrastructure Facility (SPP): - Assistance is provided on a project basis.

title: Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)" is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to promote growth in the horticulture sector through financial and technical support to farmers for cultivation, post-harvest management, and market linkage development. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should intend to cultivate horticultural crops or undertake related activities.
benefits: - Crop Development and Production: Support programs are provided for planting and increasing the production of diverse horticultural crops, including fruits, vegetables, pepper, spices, and flower crops, tailored to different regions and agro-climates within the state. - Technological Promotion: The scheme promotes and extends the use of modern technology in horticulture. - Propagation Support: Support programs are available for grafting and stem raising, contributing to better crop propagation. - Post-Harvest Management and Value Addition: Assistance is provided for post-harvest management processes and value addition initiatives, ensuring better returns for produce. - Market System Development: Financial assistance is extended to individuals and the private sector for the development of collection and market systems, aiming for comprehensive growth in horticulture. - Specific…

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture - Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to increase inland fish production and employment through reservoir-based fish farming. The scheme offers financial assistance to individuals and groups via the iKhedut portal. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: 1. The unit cost of the project for Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture (Including Composite Fish Culture, Scampi, Pangasius, and Tilapia) is ₹4,00,000/-. 1. Beneficiaries in the general category receive 40% of the unit cost as assistance. 1. Women, Scheduled Caste (SC), and Scheduled Tribe (ST) beneficiaries receive 60% of the unit cost as assistance. 1. The subsidy is jointly funded: 60% by the Government of India and 40% by the Government of Gujarat. Mode of Disbursement: Assistance is paid with a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from the State Governments (specifically, the Government of Gujarat as mentioned in the provided text). Validity: A minimum time limit of 1 year is set for reclaiming benefits.

title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: 100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to help Adivasi farmers and tribal cultivators increase crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for various agricultural inputs and equipment such as seeds, fertilizers, plant protection equipment, and pump sets. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
benefits: 100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer: - 100% soluble chemical fertilizers/nano-fertilizers of FCO-approved grade subject to 75% of the purchase price or ₹ 750/- per hectare, will be eligible for subsidy. (subject to a maximum of four hectares per account) Remark: As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35). Frequency: Every year.

title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Plant protection pesticides Gujarat
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to help Scheduled Tribe farmers and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher agricultural crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, various tools and practices are provided to the farmers at subsidised rates. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
benefits: 1. 75% of the purchase price or ₹ 750/- per hectare, whichever is lower (subject to a maximum of two hectares per account) Remarks : According to conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of Appendix-1, crop protection drugs included under Pesticides Act-1968 have to be given. Biological/herbal medicines are to be preferred. Frequency: Every year. Note: For [ Appendix-1 ](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx) . (Refer to Scheme No. 35)

title: Assistance for Establishment of On farm Storage for Sorting-Grading
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Assistance for Establishment of On-Farm Storage for Sorting-Grading" aims to prevent post-harvest spoilage in horticultural crops by providing financial assistance for constructing storage infrastructure and purchasing sorting-grading equipment for farmers across the state. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer.
benefits: - For Construction of On-Farm Infrastructure: Financial aid will be 50% of the unit cost or ₹1,50,000/- per unit, whichever is lower.- For Machinery or Equipment Purchase: Financial aid of 50% of the actual cost, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- per unit, whichever is less.

title: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed" aims to promote natural farming and hybrid seed cultivation through financial assistance to farmers. The scheme provides up to ₹20,000 per hectare to encourage sustainable agricultural practices. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be engaged in vegetable crop cultivation.
benefits: - Subsidy Assistance for Area Expansion Using Hybrid Seeds: 40% of unit cost or up to ₹20,000/- per hectare, whichever is less.- Promotion of Natural Farming in Vegetable Crops: Maximum Assistance: ₹20,000/- per hectare.

title: Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)" aims to encourage tribal farmers to bring their produce to market committees by providing financial assistance towards transportation costs. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a tribal farmer. 1. The applicant should be residing in a tribal area of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should bring their agricultural produce to a registered market committee (APMC) located in the tribal area. 1. The applicant should be the owner or cultivator of the agricultural goods transported.
benefits: Financial Assistance: ₹500/- per tonne of agricultural produce transported. Assistance is available for up to 10 tonnes per farmer, which amounts to a maximum of ₹5,000/-.

title: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Trible Area)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Tribal Area)" aims to enhance agricultural productivity by financially supporting co-operative irrigation societies in tribal areas through the installation of water distribution infrastructure. Eligibility: - Cooperative irrigation societies formed by small and marginal farmers, or any other farmers, are eligible under this scheme. - The society should be located within the state of Gujarat. - The Scheme is applicable to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
benefits: - Monetary Support: Financial help is provided for the installation of electric motors and pumps on wells and agar creeks to enhance irrigation facilities.

title: AGR-4 Scheduled Castes Sub-Plan for Distribution of Seeds and Fertilizers Input Kits at Subsidised Rates to Scheduled Caste Cultivators
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to provide subsidised seeds, fertilizers, and organic inputs to Scheduled Caste farmers to improve agricultural productivity. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
benefits: - Subsidized Rates: SC farmers receive essential agricultural inputs like seeds and fertilizers at significantly reduced costs. - Access to Quality Inputs: The scheme ensures farmers have access to high-quality minor and micro-elements, castor cake, neem cake, liquid fermented organic manure, or green manure seeds. - Reduced Cultivation Costs: By providing subsidized inputs, the scheme lowers the overall cost of cultivation, helping to improve the economic viability of farming for SC cultivators.

title: National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote organic farming practices through providing financial assistance for organic inputs and infrastructure support to farmers. Eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: Assistance is provided for a maximum of 2 hectares per farmer for inputs for organic farming, on-farm input production infrastructure, etc.

title: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
description: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a fisherman, particularly from the Kharva and Koli communities residing in the coastal talukas of Veraval, Sutrapada, and Mangrol in Junagadh district. - The applicant's fishing net must incur damage or require cutting during an operation to rescue a trapped Whale Shark. - The applicant, or the rescue team involved, must ensure the rescue operation is thoroughly documented through either videography or photography. - The applicant, under the self-documentation scheme, must photograph the trapped Whale Shark, release it on the spot, and then submit these photographs along with incident details to the Forests and Environment Department after returning to the sea coast.
benefits: Compensation for Damaged Nets Fishermen are paid compensation not exceeding ₹25,000/- (twenty-five thousand rupees) in lieu of nets that are damaged or cut during rescue operations involving trapped Whale Sharks. Conditions for Benefit Availment/Disbursement - The rescue operation must be documented through videography or photography for compensation to be paid. - The fishermen must take photographs of trapped Whale Sharks, release them on the spot, and then submit this information and photographs after returning to the coast to receive their compensation.

title: Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy
description: The policy aims to transition Gujarat's transportation sector towards electric mobility and establish the state as a manufacturing hub for electric vehicles. It provides subsidies for electric vehicle purchases and charging infrastructure development to promote sustainable transportation. Eligibility: Electric Vehicle Purchase Subsidy - The applicant must purchase electric vehicles that have taken subsidy under Government of India's Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles in India Scheme dated 8th March 2019 and any amendments thereafter. - The applicant must ensure the vehicle's ex-factory price falls within the prescribed threshold limits for each segment. - The applicant must not have claimed subsidy under any other state government scheme run by different departments. - The applicant must authenticate documents for vehicle purchase to receive Direct Benefit Transfer. Charging Infrastructure Subsidy - The applicant must set up commercial public electric vehicle charging stations for 2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, and 4-wheelers. - The applicant must not have availed subsidies under any other promotional schemes under Government of India policies or schemes. - The applicant must ensure charging stations meet guidelines and standards of Ministry of Power Circular dated 1st October 2019 and any amendments thereafter. - The applicant must be among the first 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging station developers. Manufacturing Incentives - The applicant must be involved in manufacturing electric vehicles and their components. - The applicant must comply with provisions of Gujarat Industrial Policy-2020 and subsequent applicable policies.
benefits: Electric Vehicle Purchase Incentives - 2-Wheeler: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price ₹1,50,000/-) - 3-Wheeler: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price ₹5,00,000/-) - 4-Wheeler: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price ₹15,00,000/-) Charging Infrastructure Incentives - Capital Subsidy: 25% on equipment/machinery limited up to ₹10,00,000/- per station - Electricity Duty Exemption: 100% exemption for electric vehicle charging stations during policy period - Eligibility: First 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging stations Manufacturing Benefits All provisions of Gujarat Industrial Policy-2020 applicable to electric vehicle manufacturing sector Support for setting up or upgrading facilities for electric vehicle manufacturing Conditions The beneficiary can avail subsidy under only one state government scheme and cannot claim subsidy…

title: Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers
description: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote renewable energy and clean transportation by providing a subsidy to students for the purchase of battery-operated two-wheelers from authorized manufacturers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th to 12th in the state or be a college student. 1. The applicant must purchase a battery-operated two-wheeler only from GEDA-authorized manufacturers through registered dealers.
benefits: - Subsidy Assistance: Each eligible student receives a subsidy of ₹12,000/- for the purchase of a battery-operated two-wheeler.

title: Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-Wheelers
description: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote the adoption of eco-friendly vehicles by providing a subsidy on the purchase of battery-operated three-wheelers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an individual (such as rickshaw drivers, women entrepreneurs, startups, educated unemployed individuals) or an institution (such as cooperatives, NGOs, educational institutions, local bodies, yatras). 1. The applicant must purchase a battery-operated three-wheeler from a GEDA-authorized manufacturer or dealer. 1. The applicant must apply through authorized dealers linked with GEDA.
benefits: - Subsidy Assistance: Subsidy of ₹48,000/- after the purchase of a battery-operated three-wheeler from GEDA-authorized manufacturers/dealers.

title: Training Program for A-HELP Women Workers - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
description: The scheme aims to provide community-service-based skill development and employment opportunities for women in the field of animal husbandry. Eligible women members of Self-Help Groups under the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission can apply. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a woman member of a self-help group formed under the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission. 1. The applicant must have a minimum educational qualification of eighth pass. 1. The applicant must have completed 7 days of Pashu Sakhi training.
benefits: Under this scheme, community-service-based job creation or job filling is carried out between the Animal Husbandry Department and Animal Husbandry by A-HELP workers.

title: National Livestock Mission: Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
description: The scheme aims to promote employment generation through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sectors by providing financial and institutional support to individuals and organized groups under the National Livestock Mission. Eligibility: The applicant must belong to one of the following eligible categories: - Individual Entrepreneur - Self Help Group (SHG) - Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) - Farmers Cooperative (FCO) - Joint Liability Group (JLG) - Section 8 Company
benefits: Under this scheme, employment generation is promoted through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sector.

title: Financial Assistance To Dairy Farmers Belonging To Scheduled Tribes And Scheduled Caste For Purchase Of Basic Dairy Equipments
description: The scheme aims to provide assistance to the Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste communities for the purchase of basic dairy equipments needed to run a small scale dairy farming, and to encourage the tribal population to adopt Animal Husbandry activities, especially Dairy Development Schemes. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Goa for at least five preceding years. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe or Scheduled Caste Community. - The applicant must be a Dairy Farmer. - The applicant must have at least two milch animals. - The two milch animals must be Local Cows, Indigenous cows, Cross Bred cows, Local Buffaloes, or Improved Buffaloes.
benefits: Maximum Financial Assistance - 100% subsidy shall be provided for dairy items of general use. - The subsidy is subject to a maximum amount of ₹30,000/- or the actual cost of the items, whichever is lower. - The subsidy is a one-time assistance per family. Maximum Permissible Subsidy per Item - Stainless Steel Cans (Twenty liters Capacity): ₹3,800/- (for 2 permissible units). - 500 Liters Water Tanks: ₹3,500/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Calf Nipple Bucket: ₹1,500/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Spray Pump 15 Liters Capacity: ₹2,000/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Steel Buckets: ₹2,200/- (for 2 permissible units). - 0.5 Horsepower water Pump: ₹5,000/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Ceiling Fans: ₹4,000/- (for 2 permissible units). - Steel Vessels 5 Liters Capacity: ₹900/- (for 2 permissible units). - Spade: ₹250/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Grooming Brush: ₹400/- (for 2 permissible units). -…

title: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
description: The scheme aims to improve the livelihood and nutritional security of tribal communities by providing two dairy animals at a 90% subsidy to eligible tribal livestock farmers. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must belong to special backward tribes: Baiga, Bharia, or Sahariya. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer residing in the designated districts. 1. The applicant’s selected animals must comply with minimum milk yield and age requirements. 1. The applicant must participate in pre-distribution training and follow cluster/milk route arrangements.
benefits: - Provision of 2 Dairy Animals (cow or Murrah buffalo) per beneficiary at 90% subsidy. - Animals sourced from certified breeding tracts, progressive farmers, or NABARD-approved markets, ensuring quality and health. - Minimum milk yield requirement: cows – 7 liters/day; buffaloes – 8 liters/day. - Animal age limit: calves must be under 2 months. - Disease-free, healthy animals with mandatory tagging. - Training and guidance on dairy management provided before distribution. - Milk route establishment and cluster development support provided.

title: Tour Program of Modern Laboratories
description: The scheme aims to promote biotechnology education and research by providing students, researchers, and farmers with exposure to modern laboratories, advanced research activities, and innovative technologies. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student from a government or private school, college, or university, a researcher, or a member of a farmers’ group or self-help group.
benefits: Under this tour program, eligible individuals visit modern biotechnology laboratories to learn about new research works.

title: Nandi Shala Yojana
description: The scheme aims to improve local cattle breeds through natural insemination. Under this, indigenous breeding bulls are provided on subsidy to livestock farmers in rural Gram Panchayats. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a livestock farmer. 1. The applicant should be residing in a rural area of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have a minimum of 5 cattle along with sufficient agricultural land. 1. If the applicant does not have agricultural land, they should have at least 20 cattle. 1. The applicant should be willing to maintain and use the distributed bull for community natural insemination purposes.
benefits: Cost and Subsidy - For bulls procured from outside Madhya Pradesh: ₹25,720/- per unit. - For bulls procured from within Madhya Pradesh: ₹18,260/- per unit. - Subsidy: 75% of the cost. - Beneficiary contribution: 25% of the cost.

title: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for use of Soil Conditioner
description: The scheme aims to amend the soil based on soil test reports, address pH and nutrient deficiencies in fertilization practices, and address important soil deficiencies like micronutrients that affect crop productivity. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through the Electronic Clearance System. Eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - The farmer should be cultivating a minimum of 0.1 ha in general. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme. - Farmer should possess a Soil Health Card not older than a 2-year period for availing assistance for Soil Conditioners and Micronutrients, or a certificate to that extent may be furnished by the Assistant Chemist of Soil Testing Laboratory (North/South).
benefits: Assistance for the use of Soil Conditioner - The soil conditioners like Rock phosphate, agricultural lime, dolomite, etc., would be provided a 75% subsidy limited to Rs. 6,000/- per ha for all categories of farmers and a maximum of 4 ha per farmer. - The soil conditioner shall be purchased and used by the farmer, and the subsidy shall be released after the use of the same in the field.

title: Namami Gange Yojana- Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organic farming practices among farmers residing in villages along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries. Eligibility: 1. Farmers residing in villages located along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries in Uttarakhand are eligible for assistance under this scheme.
benefits: Under the scheme, farmers are provided assistance to adopt organic farming through the formation of clusters.

title: Development of Manures & Fertilizers:  Assistance for construction/Installation of Organic Manure Units
description: The scheme aims to aid in the conversion of available on-farm organic waste into chemical-free organic manure, providing quality organic farming inputs for sustainable agriculture. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer. Eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme.
benefits: - Construction/Installation of organic manure units would be provided 75% subsidy limited to Rs. 1950/- per cu.mt. for Organic manure unit for all categories of farmer. - The standard cost for Organic manure unit would be Rs. 2600/- per cu. mt which includes 90% cost on construction/installation including mason cost and 10% on culture, decomposing material, etc. - The unit can have one or more pits with or without internal chambers and preferably be above ground level, of bricks, laterite stones, cement blocks, shahabadi/kadappa or RCC cement rings with clean internal side walls and should have adequate protection from sun and rain. - The portable organic manure unit of HDPE material and laid on prepared surface free from sharp objects and should be protected from rodents, maximum of 3 units would also be considered for subsidy @90% subsidy on the standard cost fixed and maximum amount…

title: Mukhya Mantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
description: The scheme aims to incentivize farmers for improving production and quality of specific Rabi and Kharif crops by providing an incentive payment over and above the Minimum Support Price received. It provides varying financial incentives per quintal to registered farmers selling wheat, paddy, etc. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a registered farmer. - The applicant must have registered for the e-Upajan Yojana. - The applicant must be registered in the e-Upajan system within the specified period (e.g., between 28 March and 26 May for Wheat eligibility in Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18). - The applicant must have cultivated and sold the eligible crops (Paddy, Wheat, Gram, Lentil, or Mustard) during the specified marketing season. - The applicant must sell the produce up to the limit of their registration/productivity/production capacity. - The applicant must have sold Wheat during the Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18 between 15 March 2018 and 26 May 2018 to receive the ₹265/- per quintal incentive. - The applicant must have sold Gram, Lentil, or Mustard during the Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18 between 10 April 2018 and 9 June 2018 to receive the ₹100/- per quintal incentive.
benefits: - An incentive amount of ₹200/- per quintal is provided for Paddy cultivated during Kharif 2016. - An incentive amount of ₹200/- per quintal is provided for Wheat cultivated during Rabi Marketing Season 2016-17. - An incentive amount of ₹265/- per quintal is provided for Wheat cultivated during Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18. - An incentive amount of ₹100/- per quintal is provided for Gram, Lentil (Masur), and Mustard (Sarson) cultivated during Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18. Mode, Frequency, and Time of Disbursal - Mode of Disbursal: Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) or National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT).- Frequency: One-time payment per eligible season/crop (Implied).- Time of Disbursal: Actions for depositing the incentive amounts for Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18 crops (Wheat, Gram, Lentil, Mustard) must be completed by 10 June 2018. Conditions - The incentive amount is granted…

title: Madhya Pradesh Fasal Vividhikaran (Crop Diversification) Encouragement Scheme
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
description: The scheme aims to encourage crop diversification by providing necessary inputs to farmers who shift from growing wheat and paddy. Benefits are provided primarily to the implementing Company, Firm, or Institution to cover costs related to Human Resources and Marketing, benefiting farmers. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a Company, Firm, or Institution. - The applicant must maintain all records and qualifications as a qualifying Company, Firm, or Institution. - The applicant must advise the farmer regarding the sowing of the 'Eligible Crop' and the associated Agriculture Practice (Krishi Karyapranali). - The applicant must confirm the purchase of the 'Eligible Crop'. - The applicant must execute the crop diversification work. - The applicant must make a mandatory tie-up with another Company, Firm, or Institution for the purchase of the 'Eligible Crop'. - The applicant must ensure they themselves do not purchase the crop. - The Eligible Crop must be any crop, excluding wheat (Gehun) and paddy (Dhan), that is sown in place of wheat and paddy. - The Eligible Crop must not be covered under Minimum Support Price (MSP). - Horticultural crops must also be included in the Eligible Crops.
benefits: - The scheme permits the costs incurred for necessary inputs provided to farmers to inspire them towards diversification. - The scheme primarily sanctions costs related to Human Resources (Manav Sansadhan) deployed for area overlap and Marketing (Vipanan). - The scheme generally does not sanction Capital (Poonji) expenditure. - Capital expenditure may be sanctioned only in special circumstances for Critical Equipment. - Assistance from the State Government is provided for a minimum period of 3 years. - The period of assistance may be extended based on specific needs. - The applicant organization, if eligible for other Central Government or State Government schemes for capital investment, will be facilitated to receive such assistance. Conditions - The implementation and monitoring of the scheme must ensure that work is carried out according to the determined directions and guidelines of…

title: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
ministry: Centre For Aromatic Plants, Selaqui, Dehradun
description: The scheme aims to encourage and support farmers, institutions, and groups engaged in aromatic plant cultivation to establish post-harvest management and processing facilities. Eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer, organization, or group belonging to Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer, organization, or group must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun. 1. The cluster must have plants, machinery, and equipment as per the capacity and requirements of the aromatic cultivated area.
benefits: Under this scheme, the following support is provided: - A grant of up to ₹10 lakh is available for setting up necessary machinery, equipment, distillation units, etc., for drying, storage, and processing of aromatic plants. The grant is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) at the rate of 75% in hilly areas and 50% in plain areas. - Establishment of distillation (processing) facilities to serve other farmers within the cluster. - Development of entrepreneurship among farmers.

title: Quality Test Report - Centre for Aromatic Plants
ministry: Centre For Aromatic Plants, Selaqui, Dehradun
description: The scheme aims to provide quality testing facilities at a subsidized rate to registered aromatic farmers, enabling them to obtain authentic quality reports for their produce or essential oils. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be engaged in the cultivation of aromatic plants. 1. The farmer must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun.
benefits: Under this initiative, farmers receive a 50% discount on the quality testing fee for their produce/essential oil. The quality test report enables farmers to obtain a fair market price for their oil.

title: Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers
description: BRIEF DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage farmers and youth in Goa to take up Dairy business to increase local milk production and achieve state self-sufficiency. It offers a 40% composite subsidy on milk proceeds (incentive and cattle feed subsidy) to eligible resident farmers. Eligibility: The applicant must be a farmer from Goa. The applicant must be a bona fide resident of Goa for at least the preceding five years. The applicant must be a member of the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group registered with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. The applicant must register their Dairy Farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services through the respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital. The applicant must own a cattle shed with milch animals. The applicant must produce their own milk (and not procure milk from others then pour it to the group/society in their name). The applicant must be mandatorily registered with the Agricultural Department, as an Agriculturist under the Agricultural Database.
benefits: - A composite subsidy amounting to 40% (forty percent) of the proceeds of milk supplied to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group. - Incentive on milk: 32.28% (thirty-two point two eight percent). - Incentive on cattle feed: 7.72% (seven point seven two percent). - The scheme is linked to the cattle feed subsidy scheme. Disbursement - Monthly disbursement of benefits to beneficiary's Bank account via Electronic Clearing System (ECS). - The beneficiary must have a Bank account in any Bank having a core banking system/Electronic Clearing System (ECS). Mandatory Obligations - The beneficiary must produce their own milk at their Dairy Farm. - The beneficiary must not procure milk from others and pour it to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group in their name. - The quantity of milk supplied and the number of milch animals reared by the farmers will be…

title: Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
ministry: Herbal Research And Development Institute, Mandal-Gopeshwar Chamoli, Uttarakhand
description: Under this scheme, there is a special provision for the free distribution of seeds or saplings of medicinal plants up to 3 nali and seeds or saplings of aromatic plants up to 5 nali to farmers belonging to border districts, Scheduled Castes/Tribes, and Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must have legally measured land in their name. 1. The applicant must be interested in the cultivation of herbs.
benefits: - To encourage the cultivation of herbs, a 50% government subsidy will be provided on herbal plantation materials, inputs, and related items. - By distributing seeds/saplings of medicinal plants such as Atis, Kutki, Kuth, Jatamansi, Chirayta, Van Kakri, Pyrethrum, Taggar, Manjith, Coleus, Sarpagandha, Shatavar, Silybum, Pippali, Mandukparni/Brahmi, Amymesus, Stevia, and Tilpushpi up to 3 nali, and seeds or saplings of medicinal and aromatic plants such as Feran, Black Cumin, Large Cardamom, Rosemary, Geranium, Lemongrass, Chamomile, Bay Leaf, and Amymesus up to 5 nali free of cost, farmers are encouraged to cultivate medicinal and aromatic plants and are motivated towards self-employment. - To extend the subsidy facilities provided by the State and Central Governments to farmers, ensure the availability of technical information, provide training facilities, offer the benefits of…

title: Registration of Herb Cultivators - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
ministry: Herbal Research And Development Institute, Mandal-Gopeshwar Chamoli, Uttarakhand
description: It aims to register cultivators who grow medicinal and aromatic plants, make the process of using their cultivated herbs easier, and stop the illegal collection of herbs from forests. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a cultivator of medicinal and aromatic plants. 1. The applicant must either have their own resources on their measured land or be a cultivator encouraged by the Herbal Research and Development Institute, or a cultivator beneficiary supported by any other organization, institute, department, or voluntary organization.
benefits: Registration of farmers cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants, simplification of the extraction process for cultivated herbs, and prevention of illegal exploitation of herbal resources from forest areas.

title: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
description: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom cultivation.
benefits: Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided: - Pasteurized compost is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 50 quintals per beneficiary. Similarly, mushroom spawn (seed) is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 25 kg per beneficiary. No cash is given; the pasteurized compost and spawn are provided directly by the department. - Seven-day training for mushroom growers is provided (₹1,050/- per beneficiary), of which ₹700/- is transferred to the beneficiary’s account through DBT, and ₹350/- is used for training materials and related expenses. - Farmers/mushroom growers who produce mushrooms under the scheme can sell their produce in local markets or mandis.

title: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery-Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial support, including an investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt. of India. Eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry.
benefits: - Investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- is provided. - The subsidy is provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Sources, Government of India. - This investment subsidy is specifically provided only for Companies or Societies. Conditions - The applicant must provide a Promoter’s Contribution of 10% on the cost of the vehicle. - The collateral security required in the form of immovable property, if situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry, shall be valued at not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned. - If the immovable property used as collateral security is situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry, its value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount in the case of land with a building, or not less than 200% of the loan amount if the property offered is only land. - If the unit is promoted by Women / Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe / Differently abled…

title: Allotment of Commercial Shops
description: The scheme aims to promote ease of doing business for licensed traders by providing them with well-located commercial shops in market yards (mandis). Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must hold a valid trader’s license issued by the Mandi Committee.
benefits: The scheme facilitates ease of doing business for traders by allotting them with commercial shops.

title: Agricultural Investment Grant (in Case of Crop Damage of 33% or More)
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers who suffer crop losses of 33% or more due to natural calamities such as floods, heavy rainfall, drought, hailstorms, or other notified disasters. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident farmer of Uttarakhand engaged in agricultural activities within the state. 1. The financial assistance will be applicable only for the area actually sown with crops.
benefits: Under this scheme: - ₹8,500/- per hectare is provided for Agriculture, Horticulture, and Annual Crops in unirrigated areas. A minimum of ₹1,000/- is payable. - ₹17,000/- per hectare is provided for Areas with Assured Irrigation. The minimum amount of assistance payable to any farmer will be ₹2,000/-. - For Evergreen Crops - ₹22,500/- per hectare is admissible for all types of evergreen crops. The minimum amount payable is ₹2,500/-. - ₹6,000/- per hectare is payable to Sericulture Farmers. - ₹7,000/- per hectare is payable for eri, mulberry and tussar crops. - A minimum assistance of ₹1,000/- is payable for Munga crops.

title: Bhesaj Krishi Vikas Yojana (Herbal Cultivation Programme)
description: The scheme aims to promote the cultivation of medicinal and herbal plants (Jadi-Buti) among local farmers and unemployed youth, providing sustainable employment and improving their economic well-being. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. The applicant must have at least five Nali of land available. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar card. 1. The applicant must be interested in obtaining employment opportunities through herbal cultivation.
benefits: From the cultivation of medicinal plants, the following estimated profits can be earned: - Kuth species: ₹1,000/- per nali per year- Kutki species: ₹660/- per nali per year- Big Cardamom species: ₹1,120/- per nali per year (from the fourth year onwards)- Sarpagandha species: ₹1,200/- per nali per year- Tejpata species: ₹1,200/- per nali per year (after ten years) This cultivation provides additional employment to farmers and strengthens their economic condition.

title: Spice Area Expansion
description: The scheme aims to promote and expand the cultivation of high-value spices such as ginger, chili, turmeric, and garlic among farmers by providing quality seeds and tubers at a subsidized rate, thereby increasing spice production and enhancing farmers’ income in Uttarakhand. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
benefits: - To promote spice cultivation among farmers, spice seeds and tubers (ginger, chili, turmeric, and garlic) are provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to ₹15,000/- per hectare. These seeds are available for a maximum of 4 hectares of land. - For example, if 1 kg of ginger costs ₹200/-, the farmer pays ₹100/- to the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Center, while the government bears the remaining ₹100/- as a subsidy, allowing the farmer to obtain the tuber for ₹100/-.

title: Vegetable Area Expansion
description: The scheme aims to promote and expand vegetable cultivation across the state by providing seasonal vegetable seeds to farmers at a 50% subsidy. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 2 hectares.
benefits: - To promote vegetable production, seasonal vegetable seeds are provided to farmers at a 50% subsidy. Farmers are required to apply approximately two months before planting seasonal vegetables. - For example, if a packet of bottle gourd seeds costs ₹200/-, the farmer pays ₹100/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre, while the government bears the remaining ₹100/- as a subsidy, allowing the farmer to receive the seeds for ₹100/-.

title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Stocking - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for fish seed stocking, including transportation costs, is provided to beneficiaries from Scheduled Tribes involved in inland fisheries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private units, etc., involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary fisherman must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
benefits: The 100% assistance is provided to Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries for the cost of fish seed including transportation under the Fish Seed Stocking component. Validity: Minimum 1 year required before reclaiming benefits under this component again.

title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private units, etc., involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
benefits: - Rearing from spawn to fry: The beneficiary will receive ₹90/- per 1,000 numbers. with a minimum 30% recovery. Each beneficiary will be allocated 3,00,000 spawn, and the rearing time will be 30 days.- Rearing from fry to fingerlings: The beneficiary will receive ₹260/- per 1,000 numbers. with a minimum 35% recovery. Each beneficiary will be allocated 2,00,000 fry, and the rearing time will be 60 days.- Rearing from spawn to fingerlings: The beneficiary will receive ₹460/- per 1,000 numbers. with a minimum 12% recovery. Each beneficiary will be allocated 5,00,000 spawn, and the rearing time will be 90 days. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefits can be reclaimed after a minimum of 1 year.

title: Assam Tea Plantations Provident Fund Scheme
ministry: Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare Department
description: The scheme aims to provide financial security to Assam tea plantation workers through a contributory provident fund. It benefits eligible employees earning up to ₹6,500/- per month by accumulating 12% contributions from both the worker and employer, earning interest to be paid upon retirement. Eligibility: - The applicant must be employed in a tea plantation or a tea factory in Assam. - The applicant must receive a monthly salary of up to ₹6,500/-. - The applicant must be a daily wage worker (eligible from the first day of work).
benefits: Provident Fund Accumulation: Members receive credit for their own contribution of 12% of wages and an equal 12% contribution from the employer. Interest: The accumulated deposits earn interest at a rate declared by the Board every year. Final Settlement: The total credit balance with interest is paid to the member or nominee upon retirement, resignation, death, or invalidity. Refundable Advances: Members can avail advances up to 25% of the balance or nine months' pay (whichever is less) for marriage, death ceremonies, medical treatment, or children's higher education. Housing Advance: A non-refundable advance is available for constructing or purchasing a dwelling house, equal to 24 months' wage, total contribution, or housing cost, whichever is less. Hardship Relief: A non-refundable advance is granted in cases of hardship due to natural calamities or the closure of a plantation.

title: Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana: Small Scale Goat / Sheep Farming (10+1 Capacity)
ministry: Directorate Of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha
description: The scheme aims to provide livelihood support to the interested beneficiaries to improve the livelihoods of the weaker sections of society. Through this scheme, a subsidy of 60% or 50% of the unit cost is provided to eligible beneficiaries for the establishment of one Goat / Sheep Unit (10+1). Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be interested in small, marginal farmers and landless labourers. 1. The applicant must be willing to establish a new Goat/Sheep Unit (10+1 capacity) in individual mode. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar linked at the time of submission of the application. 1. The applicant must have a suitable proposed site for the establishment of the goat/sheep unit, verified by the Block Level Inspection Team (BLIT). 1. The applicant proposal must be for a new project only (as verified by BLIT at the time of initial verification). 1. The applicant must have, or be willing to arrange, the remaining cost (after subsidy) through a bank loan or self-finance. Preference / Priority / Reservation: - Priority is given to SC, ST, Women, Transgender, and Differently-Abled categories, who are eligible for 60% subsidy. - General (Male) category applicants are eligible for 50% subsidy. - The total target is 1,875 units for SC, ST, and General (including Women, Transgender, and Differently-Abled) beneficiaries. - In case of non-availability of beneficiaries from a particular reserved category (SC or ST), the target may be interchanged among the reserved categories. If no beneficiary is available from any reserved category, the target may be allotted to the General category. - District-wise targets are specified in [Annexure-VI](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-12/Small%20scale%20goat%20sheep%20farming%2010%2C%201%20capacity.pdf) of the scheme guidelines.
benefits: 1. Cost of one Goat / Sheep Unit (10+1): Sl. No. Component Cost (in ₹) 1.Construction of a shed of 180 sq ft for 10 females, 10 Kids & one male @ ₹ 200/sq. ft₹ 36,000/-2.Cost of animals along with transportation cost - Female (5 - 6 months) @ ₹ 5000/- & Male one (6-7 months) @ ₹ 6000/-₹ 56,000/-3.Insurance Premium @ 7% for 11 animals for one year. ₹ 8,000/-4.Other miscellaneous expenses like utensils, medicines, Nutritional supplements, Deworming etc.₹ 2,000/- Total ₹ 1,02,000/- NB: Fund Expenditure under Components 3 & 4 may be interchangeable as per actual need. 2. Subsidy pattern to be released with & without shed construction as follows: Sl. No. Category Total eligible subsidy With the construction of the Goat / Sheep Shed Without the construction of the Goat / Sheep Shed 1. SC, ST, Women, Transgender, differently-abled, etc.60 % (₹ 61,200/-)₹ 61,200/-₹ 39,600/-2.General50 %…

title: Meghalaya Piggery Development Scheme
description: The Meghalaya Piggery Development Scheme is a component of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program launched by the Government of Meghalaya. It aims to employ, engage, and empower youth and rural communities by promoting piggery entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies. Eligibility: Individuals 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The entrepreneur should possess land, either self-owned or on lease, verified by the competent authority. 1. Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience in undertaking piggery. 1. The entrepreneur should have access to adequate and quality feed for the pigs. 1. The entrepreneur should have a vaccination scheme in place for the pigs. 1. The entrepreneur should have a plan for marketing the pigs and their products. 1. The entrepreneur’s village should be in an area where pig rearing is feasible. 1. The distance between the entrepreneur’s village and the nearest market should be reasonable. 1. The entrepreneur should not be a credit defaulter with any bank. 1. The entrepreneur should possess self-owned land or notarized lease land (≥15 years). Registered Entities 1. The entrepreneur should be a registered entity from Meghalaya, such as a Cooperative, Farmer Producer Company (FPC), Farmer Producer Organization (FPO), or any other legally registered group in the state. 1. The entrepreneur should possess land, either self-owned or on lease, verified by the competent authority 1. The entrepreneur should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized Institution, preferably from a Government Institute 1. Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience of undertaking piggery. 1. The entrepreneur must have access to adequate and quality feed for the pigs. 1. The entrepreneur must have a vaccination Scheme in place for the pigs. 1. The entrepreneur must have a plan for marketing the pigs and their products. 1. The entrepreneur’s village must be in an area where pig rearing is feasible. 1. The distance between the entrepreneur’s village and the nearest market must be…
benefits: 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicant, 45% by Government) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 24 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. Technical training and capacity building 1. Veterinary and farm management support 1. Market linkage for selling output 1. Mentorship and business advisory

title: Crop Input Subsidy to the Farmers for Crop Loss Due to Natural Calamities
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat who suffer crop losses due to natural calamities, based on crop damage surveys conducted by the district administration. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have suffered crop loss due to natural calamity.
benefits: - As per the assistance norms fixed by the State Government, keeping in view the natural calamities that occur from time to time

title: Assistance for Area Expansion of Spice Crops
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers for the area expansion of spice crops, including seed and rhizomatic spices, to enhance spice production in Gujarat. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be engaged in the cultivation of spice crops, such as seed spices or rhizomatic spices.
benefits: - Maximum assistance up to ₹12,000/- per hectare at 40% of the unit cost of ₹30,000/- per hectare.

title: Assistance Program for Expansion of Fruit Crop Cultivation
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for expanding fruit crop cultivation like mango, banana, papaya, etc., through intensive and ultra-intensive farming methods. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be engaged in horticultural or fruit crop cultivation.
benefits: For Intensive and Ultra-Intensive Farming of Mango, Guava, Pomegranate, Lemon, etc.: - Assistance of ₹30,000/- to ₹40,000/- per hectare. - Maximum up to 4 hectares per beneficiary. For New Plantation of Banana Tissue Culture Crop: - 40% of the incurred cost or maximum ₹50,000/- per hectare. - Maximum up to 4 hectares per beneficiary. For New Plantation of Papaya Crop: - 50% of the incurred cost or maximum ₹30,000/- per hectare. - Paid in two installments. - Maximum up to 4 hectares per beneficiary.

title: Planting Assistance Program for Hybrid Seeds of Vegetable Crops
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: This scheme offers financial assistance to farmers for the plantation of hybrid seeds and promotion of natural farming in vegetable crops across Gujarat. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. For natural farming component, the farmer must be listed by the district ATMA office or be part of a FIG practicing natural farming.
benefits: 1. Financial support of 40% of the cost incurred for the hybrid seed plantation, ₹50,000/- per hectare unit cost. 1. Maximum assistance of ₹20,000/- per hectare under both components: - Hybrid Seed Plantation. - Promotion of Natural Farming in Vegetable Crops.

title: Capital Subsidy Scheme for Setting Up Solar Plant in Milk Cooperatives in Gujarat State (Tribal Area)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to promote renewable energy and reduce electricity expenses. Through this scheme, a 75% subsidy is provided for setting up solar plants (1KW to 40KW) in milk cooperative societies in tribal areas. Eligibility: 1. A registered milk cooperative society located in the tribal areas of Gujarat shall be eligible under this scheme. 1. The society must extensively use electricity for milk collection, cooling, and processing. 1. The society must be willing to install a solar power plant with a capacity between 1KW and 40KW.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: 75% subsidy on capital cost for installation of solar systems ranging from 1KW to 40KW.

title: Scheme on Promotion of Use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) for Increasing Organic Carbon in Soil
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The "Scheme on Promotion of Use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) for Increasing Organic Carbon in Soil" offers financial assistance to promote the use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) and enhance organic carbon levels in soil. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be engaged in agricultural activities. - The applicant must be willing to adopt LFOM/FOM on their farm.
benefits: - An amount of ₹4,000/- per acre for using LFOM or FOM.

title: Mukhya Mantri Agricultural Mechanization Scheme
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The "Mukhya Mantri Agricultural Mechanization Scheme" launched by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, offers financial assistance ranging from ₹1,200/- to ₹11,00,000/- to farmers in Gujarat for purchasing agricultural machinery and farm equipment. Eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: An amount between ₹1,200/- to ₹11,00,000/- for purchasing various farm implements.

title: PMMSY: Insulated vehicles - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for Insulated vehicles. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. Preference/Reservation/Relaxation: - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
benefits: 1. The unit cost is ₹20,00,000/-. 40% assistance, i.e. ₹ 8,00,000/- for the general category and 60% i.e. assistance up to ₹12,00,000/- for women and ST/SC category beneficiaries. 1. The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India. Remarks: 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: Once in a lifetime.

title: Pashu Palan Yojana (GSKVN)
description: Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000 are provided to sanitation workers and their dependents at an interest rate of 6% for self-employment in animal husbandry or related activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a sanitation worker or a dependent of a sanitation worker. 1. The age of the applicant (sanitation worker or dependent) should be between 18 and 50 years as on the date of application. 1. Only applicant who has not previously availed any loan under any scheme of this Corporation or the Government, including their family members, are eligible to apply under this scheme. 1. Priority will be given to applicants who are BPL (Below Poverty Line), widowed, abandoned, or persons with disabilities. 1. The applicant should intend to start a self-employment venture in animal husbandry or related activities.
benefits: - Loan up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided at an interest rate of 6% to sanitation workers or their dependents for initiating animal husbandry as a business or occupation.

title: Pashu Palan Yojana (GTKVN)
ministry: Gujarat Thakor And Koli Vikas Nigam
description: The scheme aims to enhance the livelihoods of Thakor and Koli communities by providing financial assistance for animal husbandry activities such as dairy farming. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000/- are provided for the purchase of milch animals such as cows and buffaloes. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Thakor or Koli community. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years. 1. The applicant should intend to purchase cows, buffaloes, or related dairy equipment for self‑employment.
benefits: - The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to ₹1,00,000/-. - The loan is provided for animal husbandry activities such as dairy farming, boosting rural self-employment.

title: National Geoscience Awards
