This assistance covers four components: - An insulated box (₹1,000/-), - A box (₹500/-), - A renkadi (₹5,000/-), - A weighing unit (₹1,000/-). Frequency of Disbursement: This benefit can be availed once in a lifetime.

title: Akhil Bhartiya Kisan Mela and Krishi Udyog Pradarshani
ministry: Govind Ballabh Pant University Of Agriculture And Technology, Pantnagar
description: The scheme aims to provide a platform for farmers, agri-entrepreneurs, and stakeholders to access, learn about, and showcase the latest agricultural innovations, technologies, and practices. Eligibility: 1. Participants should be farmers, farmer entrepreneurs, or agriculture-related firms interested in showcasing and promoting the latest agricultural technologies.
benefits: The Fair/Exhibition is organized twice a year on the university campus.

title: Establishment of Cow Shelters
description: The scheme aims to provide proper shelter and care to unprofitable, abandoned, or roaming cattle by supporting eligible organizations in establishing and maintaining cow shelters with financial assistance from the state government. Eligibility: For the establishment of cow shelters, applications will be accepted from the following non-governmental voluntary organizations registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860: - A charitable institution registered for the welfare of cattle and other animals, a charitable institution formed for the welfare of cattle without any profit motive, or a public trust not registered under any law. - Preference will be given to organizations with a minimum of 3 years of work experience and proven capacity. - Preference will also be given to applicant institutions that own land or have taken land on lease for at least 30 years. - For eligibility for the maintenance grant, the cowshed must shelter a minimum of 25 destitute, non-profitable bovine animals in hilly areas and a minimum of 50 in plain areas.
benefits: Under the scheme, to provide proper shelter to unprofitable livestock abandoned by cattle rearers and roaming freely, the applicant organization will be eligible for a government grant of up to 90% of the total expenditure on non-recurring items, such as the construction of the main cowshed building, storage rooms, compound walls, drinking water systems, establishment of a plant for producing cow urine extract, biogas plants, and veterinary dispensaries. The maximum limit of the government grant is ₹25.00 lakh.

title: Construction of NABARD-Funded Minor Irrigation Projects - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide farmers with free and reliable irrigation facilities by constructing NABARD-funded minor irrigation projects, so that water availability improves and farming becomes easier and more productive. Eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. Under the scheme, collective irrigation projects are constructed. 1. Projects that are beneficial and essential, with a cost of ₹4.00 lakh per hectare and a benefit-cost ratio of more than 1.0, are included. 1. Check dams are constructed at suitable locations based on the proposals received and the survey conducted.
benefits: Under the scheme, farmers will be provided free irrigation facilities. The following works will be undertaken to provide irrigation facilities to the farmers under the scheme: - Solar Pump Irrigation Scheme - Pipeline / Water Channel (Gool) - Water Storage Tank / Geo-lined Tank - Construction of Check Dam (Hilly Areas) - Small Gated Weir (Plains Areas)

title: Scheme for Construction of Ideal Fish Pond in Hilly Areas
description: The scheme aims to encourage individuals and groups to construct fish ponds by providing financial assistance and to promote sustainable fish farming while enhancing livelihood opportunities in the hilly regions of the state. Eligibility: 1. All caste categories, both women and men from the hilly areas of Uttarakhand who are interested in or engaged in fish production, are eligible under this scheme. 1. The beneficiary must have land or leased land and an available water supply source within the state. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Pond clusters (a minimum of 10 ponds must be built at one location) are created to better utilize water resources in mountainous areas, individuals of all castes are eligible to receive a 50% grant for pond construction and the first year’s investment, including fish hatchery and feed. A single individual can construct up to 10 ponds, or a group of individuals may construct them collectively. - Free technical assistance is provided for rearing fish species with high growth rates. - Individual beneficiaries are eligible for a grant for pond construction up to 500 cubic meters, with a maximum grant amount of ₹2.5 lakh. - For a society, group, federation, or mangal dal, a maximum grant of ₹5 lakh is provided for pond construction up to 1000 cubic meters. - Beneficiaries are required to contribute the remaining 50% of the cost from their own resources or through a bank…

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Backyard Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to promote the rearing of ornamental fish and accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, also increase inland fish production. The scheme also employs people involved in inland fisheries activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up a Backyard Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit, with a project cost of ₹3,00,000/- per unit. - For the General Category: the scale of assistance is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less. - For Women, Scheduled Castes (SC), and Scheduled Tribes (ST) categories: the scale of assistance is 60% of the unit cost or 60% of the actual cost, whichever is less. Mode of Disbursement: 60% of the government contribution is from the Government of India, and 40% is from the State Government. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit can be availed once in a lifetime.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Large Biofloc Establishment Culture System - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs, provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities, accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, and boost inland fisheries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of the co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
benefits: The scheme provides financial assistance for the establishment of a Large Biofloc Establishment (50 tanks, 4 meter diameter and 1.5 meter height) culture system. The unit cost is ₹50,00,000/- per unit. 1. For General Category: The scale of assistance is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, paid as a subsidy.1. For Women/Scheduled Caste (S.C.) and Scheduled Tribe (ST): The scale of assistance is 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual cost, whichever is less, paid as a subsidy. Mode of Disbursement: Assistance is paid through a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from State Governments. Frequency of Disbursement: The benefit can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.

title: Livestock Health and Diseases Control
description: The Livestock Health and Diseases Control (LH&DC) scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India. Eligibility: 1. Beneficiary must be a bona fide farmer or livestock owner. 1. Beneficiary must have a valid livestock ownership document. 1. Beneficiary's livestock must be used for commercial purposes.
benefits: 1. Improved animal health and productivity : To protect livestock from diseases, which leads to improved animal health and productivity.1. Reduced economic losses: To reduce economic losses to farmers due to livestock diseases.1. Improved food security: To improve food security by ensuring a steady supply of livestock products.1. Increased employment opportunities: To increased employment opportunities in the livestock sector.1. Improved rural livelihood: To improve the livelihoods of rural people who depend on livestock for their income.

title: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries
description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to provide growers with high-quality coffee seedlings to ensure the proper establishment of plantations. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be Self-Help Groups (SHGs) or collectives of tribal growers. 1. The applicant should have procured the seed material for the coffee nursery exclusively from the Coffee Board.
benefits: Each coffee seedling is eligible for a support of ₹5.

title: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
description: The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm. Eligibility: Eligible Beneficiaries: - State Livestock Agencies - State Livestock Boards - Animal Husbandry Department, State Government
benefits: - Funding Pattern: Assistance will be provided on a cost-sharing basis of 60:40 for all States and 90:10 for North Eastern and Himalayan States.

title: National Mission on Edible Oils- Oil Palm
description: The Mission was launched with the aim to enhance the edible oilseeds production and oils availability in the country by harnessing Oil Palm area expansion, increasing CPO production and to reduce import burden on edible oils. Eligibility: Anyone is eligible to apply under the scheme.
benefits: The scheme targets to provide following benefits: 1) Enhance production and productivity of oilpalm 2) Promotion and extension of improved technologies. 3) Provision of quality planting material 4) Support for nutrient management and pest management 5) Provision of various components for Interventions covering farm implements/ machines, capacity building of farmers, water carrying pipes, Fertigation, harvesting technology, etc.

title: Rajya Dairy Udhyamita Vikas Yojna
description: The "Rajya Dairy Udhyamita Vikas Yojna", under the Animal Husbandry Department of Chhattisgarh, aims to promote dairy entrepreneurship among youth. With the increasing demand for milk and dairy products, the scheme supports high-breed cow/buffalo rearing as a profitable business. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh for at least five years. 1. The applicant should be purchase a maximum of two milch animals under the scheme. 1. The applicant should be entitled to 50% subsidy (up to ₹70,000/-) for general category and 66.6% subsidy (up to ₹93,200/-) for SC/ST category. 1. The applicant should be responsible for any additional costs beyond the scheme’s provisions, with no subsidy provided for the excess amount. 1. The applicant should ensure that the purchased animal is in milk production, not older than five years, and capable of producing at least 10 liters of milk per day at the time of purchase. 1. The applicant should have the animal insured for a minimum period of three years (total five years recommended) at the time of unit setup. 1. The applicant should be a landless, small or marginal farmer, BPL family member, milk co-operative society member, village resident on a milk collection route, Garva Yojana beneficiary, women SHG member, or an existing dairy farmer, as they will receive priority. 1. The applicant should be the only eligible beneficiary from a joint family. 1. The applicant should not own at least two high-breed dairy animals at the time of applying for the scheme.
benefits: Dairy Unit Grant Details 1. Financial Assistance for Dairy Units - Eligible Animals: Indian dairy breeds (Sahiwal, Red Sindhi, Gir, Tharparkar, etc.), advanced crossbreed cows, and high-breed buffaloes.- Maximum Limit: Financial support for up to two milch animals.- Total Finance Cost: ₹1,40,000/- (₹70,000/- per animal, including three years of insurance). 2. Subsidy Details For General Category Beneficiaries: - 50% subsidy on the actual cost, up to ₹70,000/- per unit. - For SC/ST Beneficiaries: 66.6% subsidy, up to ₹93,200/- per unit. Note: Unit cost per animal is based on the Government of India’s guidelines (Letter No. F 1-1/2009-DP, dated 02 May 2018).

title: State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme
description: The "State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme", initiated by the Animal Husbandry Department of Chhattisgarh, aims to promote goat farming as a sustainable livelihood option. Goat rearing has been a traditional occupation, and with increasing demand for milk and meat. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh for at least five years. 1. The applicant should be linked to a loan from a Nationalized, Cooperative, or Regional Rural Bank. 1. The applicant should be willing to sign a contract with the department to operate the unit for at least three years. 1. The applicant should be eligible for the grant only after obtaining the Unit Establishment Verification Certificate, a demand letter from the bank, and submitting necessary documents. 1. The applicant should be the only person from a joint family applying for the grant. 1. The applicant should be aware that a joint family receiving benefits under the scheme cannot reapply for the next five years.
benefits: Financial Assistance Under the State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Total finance cost: ₹1,00,000/- per goat unit (30 goats + 2 improved breed goats).- For general category beneficiaries: 25% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹₹25,000/-- For SC/ST beneficiaries: 33.3% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹33,300/-.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
description: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must belong to either the General, Scheduled Caste (SC), or Women category. 1. The applicant must be the owner or legal leaseholder (with a minimum 10-year lease) of the land intended for setting up the unit. 1. The applicant must have access to either surface water or groundwater for aquaculture purposes. 1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate in fisheries or aquaculture. 1. The applicant must be willing to maintain and operate the unit at personal cost after the initial setup. 1. The applicant must submit a complete Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) for evaluation. 1. The applicant must agree to sign an official agreement with the Fisheries Department to avail of benefits under the scheme.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹50,00,000/- RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture System) Subsidy: 1. A 20% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 25% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries. Biofloc Subsidy: 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana
description: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up small-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must own land or have a registered lease of at least 10 years, free from legal encumbrances. 1. The applicant must have access to a water source such as a canal, well, tube well, or similar. 1. The applicant must be trained in aquaculture or fisheries and hold a valid certification. 1. The applicant must be willing to maintain and operate the system at their own cost post-installation. 1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP). 1. The applicant must sign an agreement with the Fisheries Department to be eligible under the scheme.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹7,50,000/- Subsidy Distribution: - A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. - A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Purchase of Fishing Nets (Scheduled Caste)
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals from Scheduled Caste families engaged in fishing activities for the purchase of fishing nets. Under this scheme, a 60% subsidy or up to ₹24,000, on the purchase of fishing nets worth ₹40,000/- will be provided to eligible beneficiaries. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years old. 1. The applicant should present a GST-paid bill for the purchase of fishing nets. 1. The applicant can apply only once in two years for this subsidy.
benefits: Financial Assistance is provided to Fish Farmers under the scheme: - Financial assistance of 60% subsidy on the purchase of fishing nets of amounting to ₹40,000/-. - The maximum subsidy amount is ₹24,000/-. Note: Subsidy is available only once in two years per beneficiary.

title: Distribution of Horticulture Kit to Urban and Rural Areas
description: Through this scheme, all the horticulture growers in rural & urban areas are provided with a horticulture kit worth ₹ 3,000 per kit to urban and rural areas, during Aadipattam/Thaipattam, through the Additional Director of Agriculture (Horticulture). Eligibility: All horticulture growers of rural & urban areas are eligible.
benefits: 75% subsidy, i.e. distribution of horticulture kit worth ₹ 3,000 per kit to urban and rural areas (homestead/backyards), through the Additional Director of Agriculture (Horticulture), during Aadipattam/Thaipattam seasonality.

title: Male Pig Distribution Scheme
description: The "Male Pig Distribution Scheme", under the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, provides a grant to beneficiaries from the SC/ST category for purchasing one male pig of an improved breed (Middle White Yorkshire). Eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh. 1. The beneficiary should purchase a male pig of the improved breed (Middle White Yorkshire). 1. The pig should be between the 6th months the 1st year of age. 1. The purchase should be made from a Government-rearing project or a local authorized source.
benefits: 90% of the unit cost (purchase price) or a maximum subsidy of ₹3,500/-, whichever is lower (for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) category).

title: Paddy Transplantor Machine se Dhan Ropayee par Anudan
ministry: Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Bio-Technology Department
description: The scheme aims to promote mechanized paddy transplantation under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. It provides ₹3,000 per acre for land preparation, including ploughing and weeding, up to 2 hectares. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a farmer residing in the Chhattisgarh. 1. The applicant should be engaged in paddy cultivation. 1. The applicant should be willing to use a paddy transplanter machine for transplantation. 1. The applicant should be preparing a mat-type nursery for paddy transplantation. 1. The applicant should have suitable land for ploughing and weeding. 1. The applicant should have a cultivable area of up to 2 hectares to be eligible for the grant.
benefits: (A) Field Preparation Expenditure per Hectare: - Field Ploughing (5 hours @ ₹700 per hour): ₹3,500/- - Field Weeding (6 hours with Rotavator @ ₹700 per hour): ₹4,200/- - Total Field Preparation Cost: ₹7,700/- (B) Expenditure for Seedling Preparation per Hectare: - Plastic Sheet for Nursery (15 Kg @ ₹100 per Kg): ₹1,500/- - Field Weeding (6 hours with Rotavator @ ₹500 per hour): ₹3,000/- - Other Expenses (Soil, Manure, Sand, Water - arranged by the farmer): Not Included - Additional Contingencies: ₹500/- - Total Seedling Preparation Cost: ₹5,000/- Total Expenditure per Hectare: - Field Preparation (A) + Seedling Preparation (B): ₹7,700 + ₹5,000 = ₹12,500/- per hectare - Cost per Acre: ₹5,080/- Subsidy Details: - Subsidy Amount: 75% of the cost - Maximum Subsidy Limit: ₹3,800/- per acre

title: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond)
short_name: CHIEF MINISTER SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE IRRIGATION SCHEME
description: Under this scheme subsidy payable to individual farmer is minimum Rs.14433/- and maximum Rs.75000/- depending on the size of the farm pond. Eligibility: 1) Farmer should hold at least (Minimum) 0.20 ha. land and Kokan region, while it is 0.40 ha. limit for rest of Maharashtra. 2) The applicant farmers land will have to be technically suitable for digging farm pond. So that the runoff rainwater can be stored in the farm pond through natural flow and recharge will be possible. In case of farm ponds without inlet and outlet there should be a natural source from where extra runoff during rainy season can be lifted and stored in farm pond. 3) Before applying for farm pond, the applicant farmers should not have availed the subsidy for farm pond, community tank or bodi in paddy bunding or any Government Scheme.
benefits: 1) Financial Assistance is given to farmers. 2)The subsidy payable to an individual farmer minimum Rs.14433/- and maximum Rs.75000/- depending on the size of the farm pond.

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles
description: The scheme aims to strengthen the fisheries value chain by providing transportation support to fish farmers. Under this scheme, eligible fish farmers receive a subsidy of 25% of the actual cost on the purchase of a commercial four-wheeler vehicle used for fisheries-related activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
benefits: - Subsidy under the scheme is provided at the rate of 25% of the actual cost of the four-wheeler (₹9 lakh) or ₹2.25 lakh, whichever is lower.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles – Haryana
description: The scheme aims to enhance cold chain infrastructure & ensure hygienic and efficient fish transportation. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing refrigerated vehicles to maintain the freshness & quality of fish during post-harvest handling & transportation. Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that the refrigerated vehicle remains operational for fish transportation. 1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only one refrigerated vehicle. 1. The applicant should utilize the refrigerated vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities. 1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchase, operation, maintenance, and management of fish transport facilities.
benefits: Financial Assistance provided under the scheme: - Project Cost: ₹25,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
description: The scheme provides capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must have access to own land or hold a registered lease for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The applicant must ensure that the land is free from any legal and financial encumbrances. 1. The applicant must have access to a reliable water source such as a canal, tube well, river, or similar. 1. The applicant must provide a valid training certificate in fisheries or aquaculture. 1. The applicant must agree to manage and maintain the system at their own cost after setup. 1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP). 1. The applicant must sign an agreement with the Department of Fisheries to avail benefits under the scheme.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹25,00,000/- Subsidy Distribution: 1. 40% subsidy for General Category beneficiaries. 1. 60% subsidy for SC and Women category beneficiaries.

title: To Provide Interest Subvention to Animal Husbandry of the State at the Rate of 4% to the Beneficiaries Kisan Credit Card
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme aims to provide 4% interest subvention to cattle breeders in Gujarat on timely repayment of short-term loans taken through the Kisan Credit Card for animal husbandry activities. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a cattle breeder. 1. The applicant must have taken a short-term loan from any of the following during the financial year: - Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Society - District Central Cooperative Bank - Nationalized Bank - Gramin Bank - Private Bank 1. The applicant must have repaid the loan on time.
benefits: Name of Component Standard of Assistance Minimum Time Limit (in Year) for Reclaiming Benefits) To provide interest subvention to animal husbandry of the state at the rate of 4% to the beneficiaries Kishan Credit Card.4% interest subvention on timely repayment of short-term loan taken by animal husbandry up to ₹2,00,000/-. only once in a financial year

title: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)" provides 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed to General Category livestock owners after parturition to support cattle health, increase milk production, and enhance calf development. Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a livestock owner. 1. The applicant must belong to the General Category. 1. The animal must have recently calved (given birth).
benefits: Name of Component Standard of assistance Remarks Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits Concentrate Feed 150 kg BIS type II Concentrate feed per beneficiary100% assistanceEvery year
